verses.text: Ahab a sih khit ciangin Moab-te in Israyl-te lehdo hi.

Tu-in Samaria-a a inndei tungnung innliim umna panin Ahazyah kia-in a liam hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in kamtaite sawlin, amau kiangah, “Pai unla, hih ka liamna panin ka damzo ding hiam cih ka theih nadingin Ekron-te pasian (el) Baal-Zebub kiangah va dong un,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in Tishbite mi Yliyah kiangah, “Ding inla, Samaria kumpipa’ kamtaite va dawntuahin, amau kiangah, ‘Ekron-te’ pasian Baal-Zebub kiang thu dong dingin na pai uh, Israyl sungah Pa a om loh hang ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: na kualna mun na lupna panin na paikhia kei ding hi! Na si taktak ding hi!’ ci in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yliyah a pai hi.
Kumpipa kiangah kamtaite hong tunkik uh ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin hong ciahkik na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Amaute in ama kiangah, “Mi khat in kote hong dawntuahin ko kiangah, “Pai un, no hong sawl kumpipa kiangah ciahkik un; tua ciangin ama kiangah, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ekron-te pasian Baal-Zebub kiang thu dong dingin na sawl nadingin Israyl sungah Pa a om lohna hang ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin na kualna mun na lupna panin na paikhia kei ding a, na si taktak ding hi,’ ci un,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “No kiangah hong pai-in hih thute hong gen mi a bangci khat ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Amah pen kamsang puantualpi khat silhin a kawngah savun kawnggak khat a gak mi khat ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Amah pen Tishbe mi Yliyah aive maw!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah in Yliyah a la dingin sawmnga a uk galkap bupa a mite tawh a sawl hi. Ama kiangah sawmnga a uk bupa pai a, mual dawn ah amah na tu hi. Sawmnga a uk bupa in ama kiangah, “Yahweh’ mipa, kumpipa in thu hong pia hi—hong paisuk in!” ci-in thu a pia hi.

Yliyah in dawngkikin sawmnga a uk bupa kiangah, “Yahweh’ mi khat ka hih leh, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk henla, nang leh na mi sawmngate hong kangtum hen,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin vantung panin meikuang hong paisukin, galkap bupa leh sawmngate a kangtum hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in amah a la dingin sawmnga a uk galkap bu adang khat a mite tawh sawl hi. Sawmnga a uk bupa in, “Yahweh’ Mipa, kumpipa in thu hong pia hi—hong paisuk in!” ci-in thu a pia hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in dawngkikin, sawmnga a uk bupa kiangah, “Yahweh’ mi khat ka hih leh, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk henla, nang leh na mi sawmngate kangtum tahen,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin vantung panin Yahweh’ meikuang hong paisukin, a nihna galkap bupa leh a sawmngate a kangtum hi.

Kumpipa in a thumveina-in sawmnga a uk galkap bupa leh a mi sawmngate a sawl leuleu hi. Tua ciangin sawmnga a uk galkap bu a thumnapa paito-in amah tung a, Yliyah mai-ah a khukdin hi. Amah in thuum bawlin, “Yahweh’ Mipa aw, nangma muhna ah keima nuntakna leh hih na nasem sawmngate nuntakna hong thusimsak in.
En in, vantung panin meikuang hong kiasukin, sawmnga a uk galkap bu tenih leh a sawmngate uh kangtum hi. Ahi zongin nangma muhna ah ka nuntakna tu-in hong thusimsak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in Yliyah kiangah, “Amah tawh paisuk in. Amah kihta kei in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah ding a, kumpipa kiangah bupa tawh a paisuk hi.

Amah in kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ekron-te pasian Baal-Zebub kiang thu dong dingin kamtaite na sawlkhin hi; Israyl sungah Ama kammal dot dingin Pa a om loh hang ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin na kualna mun lupna panin na paikhia kei ding a, na si taktak ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yliyah gensa Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in Ahazyah a si hi. Amah in tapa nei lo ahih manin Yahram in Israyl kumpi’ za luah a, Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat’ tapa Yahram’ uk zawh a kum nihna kum sung ahi hi.
Tu-in Ahazyah’ uk hun sunga thupiang a omlai teng leh a sep teng Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Yahweh in huih laka pingpei tungah Yliyah a tuansak kuan ciangin, Gilgal panin Yliyah leh Ylisha a dingkhia uh hi.

Yliyah in Ylisha kiangah, “Yahweh in Beth-El ah kei hong sawlkhin ahih manin tu-in hih lai-ah na om in,” a ci ahi hi. Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Yahweh nungta-in nang zong nungta na hih mah bangin, nang kong nusia kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Beth-El ah a paisuk uh hi.

Ylisha a dawn dingin Beth-El a om kamsang pasalte hong pai uh a, ama kiangah, “Tuni-in nang kiang panin na makaipa Yahweh in a lak ding lam na thei hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ylisha in, “Hi hi, ka thei hi; ahih hangin hih thu gen kei in,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in ama kiangah, “Ylisha aw, Yahweh in Yericho ah kei hong sawl ahih manin tu-in hiah na om in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Yahweh nungta-in nang zong nungta na hih mah bangin nang kong nusia kei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yericho ah a paisuk uh hi.

Ylisha a dawn dingin Yericho-a om kamsang pasalte hong paikhia uh a, ama kiangah, “Tuni-in nang kiang panin na makaipa Yahweh in a lak ding lam na thei hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ylisha in, “Hi hi, ka thei hi; ahih hangin hih thu gen kei in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yliyah in Ylisha kiangah, “Yahweh in Yardan ah kei hong sawl ahih manin tu-in hih lai-ah na om in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Yahweh nungta-in nang nungta na hih mah bangin nang kong nusia kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau tegel a tonkhawm uh hi.
Yardan kiangah amau tegel a din laitakun kamsang pasalte mi sawmnga hong pai-in amaute enin a gamla sim khat ah a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yliyah in a puantualpi; tallit, suahkhia-in zial a, tua tawh tui a sat hi. Tua ciangin veilam leh taklam ah a tui kikhen a, amau tegel in leikeu tung tawnin Yardan a kantan uh hi.

Amaute in a kantan khit deuh ciangin, Yliyah in Ylisha kiangah, “Thu hong dong in! Nang kiang panin kei hong kilak ma-in nang aa dingin bang hong hihsak ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Ylisha in, “Na kha a zah nih kei hong ngahsak in,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Thu haksa khat nong ngen hi; ahi zongin nang kiang panin kei hong kilak na muh leh, hih thu na ngah ding a—ahi zongin na muh kei leh, na ngah kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute tonkhawmin a kihoho laitakun, amau tenih kikalah meikuang sakolleeng khat leh meikuang sakolte hong omvat a, huih laka pingpei tungah Yliyah a tuang hi.

Ylisha in tua mu a, “Ka Pa! Ka Pa! Israyl’ sakolleengte leh sakol tuangte!” ci-in a kiko hi. Tua zawh ciangin Ylisha in amah a mu nawn kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a puantualpi; tallit, lenin, phel nihin a balkek hi.
Amah in Yliyah tung panin a kiakhia puantualpi tawm a, amah kilehkikin, Yardan gun nawl ah a ding hi.

Tua ciangin amah in Yliyah tung pana a kiakhia puantualpi la-in, tua tawh tui sat a, “Israyl’ Pa Yahweh koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in tui a sat ciangin veilam leh taklam ah tui kikhenin, Ylisha in leikeu tung tawnin a kantan hi.
Yericho pana pai kamsang pasalte in amah en uh a, amaute in, “Ylisha tungah Yliyah’ kha tung hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah dawn dingin amaute pai uh a, ama mai leilak ah a bok uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, “En in! Ko na nasemte in ahi thei ding mi sawmnga ka nei uh hi. Amaute pai henla, na makaipa va zong uh hen. Yahweh’ Kha in amah a domto hi kha ding a, mualtung khatpeuh ahih keileh kuam sung khatpeuh ah koih kha thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Amaute sawl kei un,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in amah a maizum dongin kun tentan uh ahih manin amah in, “Amaute sawl un!” a ci hi. Amaute in mi sawmnga sawlin ni thum sung zong uh a, ahih hangin Yliyah a mu kei uh hi.
Yericho ah Ylisha om ahih manin ama kiangah amaute hong tunkik uh ciangin, amah in amaute kiangah, “Pai kei un, hong ci mah hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin khua sung mite in Ylisha kiangah, “En in, ka ukpa in na muh mah bangin hih khuapi omna mun pen nuam a, ahih hangin tui hoih loin, leitang ah bangmah a piang kei hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amah in, “Thawl gongbak a thak khat hong paipih unla, a sungah ci koih un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama kiangah a paipih uh hi.

Tua ciangin tui lakna bulpi ah amah pai-in tua lai-ah ci theh a, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih tui ka damsak khin hi. Cikmahin sihna piangsak nawn lo ding a, leitang bangmah pianglosak nawn lo ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ylisha gensa kammal tawh kizui-in tuni dongin tua tui a hoih paisuak hi.
Yericho panin Beth-El ah Ylisha a pai hi. Lampi ah a pai laitakin khua sung panin khangno pawlkhat paikhia-in zahpihna tawh a nuihsan uh hi. Amaute in, “Talkolhpa paito! Talkolhpa paito!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah kihei-in amaute en a, Yahweh’ Min tawh amaute tungah samsiatna khat a genkhia hi. Tua ciangin singlak panin vompi a nu nih hong paikhia-in khangno sawmli le nihte a phuaizawp hi.
Tua ciangin Beth-El panin Carmel Mual ah amah pai a, tua lai panin Samaria ah a kilehkik hi.
Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat’ uk zawh a kum sawm le kum giatna kumin Samaria ah Ahab’ tapa Yahram Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in kum sawm le kum nih uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta a, ahih hangin a nu leh a pa gamtat bangin a gamta kei hi. Amah in a pa bawlsa Baal khuampi siangtho; massebah, a beisak hi.
Ahi zongin Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate zom lai a, tuate panin a kiheikhia kei hi.
Tu-in Moab kumpipa Mesha in tuu tamna gam uk a, amah in Israyl kumpipa kiangah tuuno 100,000 leh tuutal 100,000 a puak kul den hi.
Ahi zongin Ahab a sih ciangin Moab kumpipa in Israyl kumpi a lehdo hi.
Tua ciangin Samaria panin kumpi Yahram kuankhia-in, Israyl khempeuh a kawm hi.

Amah in Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat kiangah kamtai khat zong sawl a, “Moab kumpipa in kei hong lehdo hi. Moab sim dingin kei tawh nong kuan khawm ding hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Nang tawh kong kuan khawm ding hi. Kei pen nangmah bang ka hi hi. Ka mite zong nang mi dan mah ahi hi. Ka sakolte zong nang sakol dan mah ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshaphat in, “Bang lampi zui-in kuanto ding i hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Edom Sehnel gam lampi i zui ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpipa dingkhia a, Yahdah kumpipa leh Edom kumpipa a kuankhawm uh hi. Amaute ni sagih sung kual pai uh a, tua khit ciangin galkapte in amau aa ding ahi a, amau tawh a om ganhingte aa ding ahi zongin tui a nei nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in, “Ala! Moab-te khut sungah eite hong pia lel dingin Yahweh in hih kumpi thumte khawmin hong samkhia hi!” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshaphat in, “Ama tungtawnin Yahweh kiang i dot theih nadingin hih lai-ah Yahweh’ kamsang omlo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa’ uliante khat in, “Yliyah’ khut tungah tui a sung zel; Yliyah aa dinga na a sepsak den, Shaphat’ tapa Ylisha hiah om hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshaphat in, “Yahweh’ kammal amah tawh om hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama kiangah Israyl kumpipa, Yahshaphat leh Edom kumpipa a paisuk uh hi.

Tua ciangin Ylisha in Israyl kumpipa kiangah, “Nang tawh ka neihkhop bang om ahi hiam? Na pa’ kamsangte leh na nu’ kamsangte kiangah pai in!” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Israyl kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Hilo hi! Moab-te khut sungah kote hong pia dingin kumpi thumte hong khawmin hong sampa pen Yahweh ahi hi!” a ci hi.
Ylisha in, “Ama na kasep Vanglianpen Yahweh nungta taktak ahih manin, ka zahtak Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat a om hang hi keileh, nang en zong kong en kei ding a, zong kong theisak kei ding hi!
Ahih hangin tu-in harp khausai tum thei khat hong paipih un! Harp a tum laitakin, Ylisha tungah Yahweh’ khut hong tung a,
Tua ciangin amah in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih kuam ah tuilamte tawh kidim hen, a ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Note in huih ahi a, guah ahi zongin na mu kei ding uh a, ahi zongin hih kuam pen tui tawh kidim ding hi—tua ciangin note, na bawnghonte leh na ganhing dangte in na dawn thei ding uh hi.
Hih pen Yahweh mi ah a baih thu khat ahi hi. Amah in na khut sungah Moab mite zong hong pia ding hi.

Nangmah in kulh tawh ki-um khuapi peuhpeuh leh khuapi thupi peuhpeuh na lawnthal ding hi. Singkung lianpi peuhpeuh na phuktan ding a, tuinak peuhmah khakin, lo hoihna peuhpeuh suangtum tawh na susia ding hi.
A zingciang zingsang, biakpiakna hun ciangin Edom lam panin thakhatthu-in tui hong luang a, gam sung ah tui a dim hi.
Tu-in Moab mite khempeuh in amaute sim dingin Israyl kumpite a kuantohna thu za uh ahih manin a moi a ham galhiam tawi thei peuhmah in a gamgi uh ah mun a la uh hi.
Zingsangin amaute thobaih uh a, tui tungah ni a tang hi. A gala om Moab mite muhna ah tui pen sisan bangin a sanin a kimu hi.
Amaute in, “Hua pen sisan hi! Kumpite kido-in khat le khat kithat uh hi taktak hi! Moab-te aw, van kinusiatna ah!” a ci uh hi.
Israyl-te giahphual ah Moab mite a tun uh ciangin Israyl-te dingto-in Moab mite sim uh a, amaute mai panin Moab-te a taimang uh hi. Amau gam ah Israyl lutin Moab mite a thatmang uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in a khuapi susia-in gam hoihna mun khempeuh ah mi khempeuh in suang a dim dongin a lawn uh hi. Amaute in a tuinakte uh khakcipin, singkung golpi peuhmah a phuktan uh hi. Kir Haresheth bek ah suangtumte a mun ah omin, ahih hangin suanglawn mite in umcihin a do veve uh hi.
Gal in ama lam a neh semsem lam Moab kumpipa in a theih ciangin Edom kumpipa kiang lam phulet dingin amah in namsau tawi mi za sagih tawh kithawi a, ahih hangin amaute in a hihzo kei uh hi.

Tua ciangin amah in ama kumpi’ za a luah ding a tapa upen la-in, mi khempeuh in hoih takin a muh theihna mun khuapi kulhpi tungah biakpiakna-in a pia hi. Kilatvatna leh kihluatna in Israyl-te lungkimlosak mahmah hi. Tua mun panin amaute nungkikin amau gam ah a ciahkik uh hi.

Ylisha tungah kamsang pasalte khat’ zi kiko-in, “Na nasempa ka pasal si a, na nasempa in Yahweh a zahtakna thu na thei hi. Ahi zongin tu-in a leibatnapa in a sila dingin ka tapa tenih la dingin hong pai ding hi,” a ci hi.

Ylisha in tuanu kiangah, “Nang aa dingin bang hong hihsak ding ka hi hiam? Hong gen in, na inn sungah bang nei na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in, “Na nasemnu in sathau biing khat simloh inn sungah bangmah ka nei kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Pai inla, na veng kiim khempeuh—na vengte khempeuh kiangah beel hawm va ngen in. Tawmno bek khawm kei in.
Tua khit ciangin tum inla, nang leh na tapate nunga kongkhak khak in. Tua beelte khempeuh sungah sathau sung unla, a dimsate tuam koih un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiang panin tuanu pai-in, tua khit ciangin amah leh a tapate nunga kong a khak uh hi. Amaute in beelte tuanu kiangah hong paipihin, tuanu in sathau a sung hi.

Beelte khempeuh a dim ciangin, amah in a tapa kiangah, “Beel dang khat hong la lai in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, “Beel dang om nawn lo hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin a sathau a luangkhia nawn kei hi.
Tuanu hong paikhia-in Yahweh’ mipa a gen hi. Amah in tuanu kiangah, “Pai inla, sathaute zuakin na leibate loh in. A omlai teng tawh nang leh na tapate na nungta thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ni khat Shunem ah Ylisha pai a, tua lai-ah thupi-in hehpihna a nei numei khat in an ne-in a khawl nadingin a kho hi. Tua ahih manin amah in tua lai a tot simin an ne dingin a khawl hi.
Tuanu in a pasal kiangah, “Amah pen hih lai-a hong khawl zel Yahweh’ mi siangtho khat ahih lam ka thei hi.

Eite in kulhbaang tungah inndei tungnung a neu khat bawlin, tua lai-ah ama aa dingin lupna khat, sabuai khat, tutphah khat, leh meivak khat i koihsak dia? Tua ciangin hi bang hong hi ding a, ei kiangah amah hong pai peuhpeuh ciangin hih lai-ah amah khawl thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ni khat Ylisha hong pai ciangin, ama inndei ah amah kahto-in tua lai-ah a kual hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a nasem Gehazi kiangah, “Hih Shunem mi numeinu hong sam in,” a ci hi. Amah in tuanu a sap khit ciangin, ama mai-ah tuanu a ding hi.

Ylisha in tuapa kiangah, “Tuanu tungah gen in: ‘En in, kote aa dingin nong lunghimawh a, nong awlmawh hi. Nang aa dingin kong hihsak theih ding bang om ahi hiam? Kumpipa kiangah ahi a, galkap mangpa kiangah ahi zongin nangma tangin thu nong gensak nuam hiam?’ ci in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin tuanu in, “Ka mipihte lakah inn khat ka nei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ylisha in, “Tua ahih leh tuanu aa dingin bang kihihsak thei ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Gehazi in, “Hoih hi, tuanu in tapa nei lo a, a pasal teekta hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Tuanu sam in,” a ci hi. Amah in tuanu a sapkhit ciangin kongkalai ah tuanu a ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Khuakhal hun sungin nangmah in tapa khat na tawi ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin tuanu in, “Hilo hi, Yahweh’ mipa ka ukpa aw! Na nasemnu hong khem kei in!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin numeinu gai a, Ylisha in tuanu a gensa bang lianin khuakhal hun sungin tapa khat a nei hi.
Naupang hong gol ta hi. Tua ciangin ni khat an late laka om a pa kiangah amah hong pai a,
amah in a pa kiangah, “Ka lutang! Ka lutang!” a ci hi. A pa in nasem khat kiangah, “A nu kiangah puak in,” a ci hi.
Nasempa in amah la-in a nu kiangah a puak khit ciangin, a nu phei tungah sun dong tu-in tua khit ciangin a si hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu paito-in Yahweh’ mipa lupna tungah amah sialin, kong khaknelhin a paikhia hi.
Tuanu in a pasal samin, “Yahweh’ mipa kiangah kei vatai-in tua khit ciangin kong ciahkik theih nadingin tangval khat leh laa khat kei kiangah nong sawl thei ding hia?” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amah in, “Ama kiangah tuni-in bang hangin pai ding na hi hiam? Kha Thak lah hi loin, Shabbat ni zong hilo himah lo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tuanu in, “Tua in kei phattuam nading ahi hi” ci-in a dawng hi.
Laa tunga tutphah tungah tuanu tu-in a nasempa kiangah, “Hong mapi in! Kong gen kei nak leh, kei aa dingin dampaisak kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu pai-in Carmel Mual-a Yahweh’ mipa kiangah a tung hi. Yahweh’ mipa in a gamla simsima tuanu a muh ciangin amah in a nasempa Gehazi kiangah, “En in, Shunem mi numeinu!
Ama kiangah va tai inla, ‘Na dam hia? Na pasal e a dam hia? Na naupang e a dam hia?’ ci-in dong in,” a ci hi. Tuanu in, “Shalom,” a ci hi.

Mual tunga Yahweh’ mipa kiangah tuanu a tun ciangin tuanu in a khe panin amah mancipin, tuanu sawnkhia dingin Gehazi a pai hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh’ mipa in, “Tuaci omsak lel in! Amah nakpi takin lunggim a, Yahweh in tua thu kei hong im-in, kei hong gen lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu in, “Ka ukpa aw, tapa hong ngen ka hi hiam? ‘Kei hong khem kei in,’ ci-in nang hong gen mah hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Ylisha in Gehazi kiangah, “Na kawngah na puantual gak inla, na khut sungah ka ciangkhut tawi-in va tai in! Mi khatpeuh tawh na kituah leh, hopih kei inla, mi khatpeuh in nang hong hopih leh zong, amah dawngkik kei in! Tua ciangin naupangpa’ maitang ah ka ciangkhut na va nga ding hi,” a ci hi.
Naupang’ nu in, “Yahweh nungta-in nang nungta na hih mah bangin nang kong paisan kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah dingto-in tuanu a zui hi.

Amaute mai-ah Gehazi na paikhol a, naupangpa’ maitang ah ciangkhut a nga hi; ahih hangin awging ahi a, dawnkikna ahi zongin a om kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin Ylisha dawn dingin Gehazi kilehkikin, ‘Naupangpa khanglo tuan lo hi,’ ci-in a gen hi.
Inn sungah Ylisha a tun ciangin, Ylisha’ lupna tungah a sisa-a kisial naupangpa na om hi.
Amah a sungah lutin, amau gel bek a sungah omin kong khak a, Yahweh kiangah thu a ngen hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah dingto-in naupang tungah a boksuk hi. Amah in naupang’ kam ah ama kam tuahin, naupang mit ah ama mit tuahin, naupang’ khut tungah ama khutte koihin ama tungah a kikhuang hi—tua ciangin naupang’ pumpi a lum hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah dingto-in, hih lam pangah khatvei, adang khat lamah khatvei kilehin inndei sungah pai a, tua khit ciangin naupang tungah khatvei a kikhuang leuleu hi. Naupang sagih vei hetchei-in a mitte a hak hi.
Ylisha in Gehazi samin ama kiangah, “Hih Shunem numeinu hong sam in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tuanu a sam hi. Tuanu hong pai ciangin amah in tuanu kiangah, “Na tapa la in,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuanu a sungah lutin, a khephung ah puk a, leilak ah a boksuk hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in a tapa la-in a pusuak hi.

Gilgal ah Ylisha ciahkik a, tua gam sungah kialpi a tung hi. Tu-in amah tawh kamsang pasalte thu a kikum uh a, amah in a nasempa kiangah, “Beelpi khat suang inla kamsang pasalte aa dingin meh huan in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin lo sungah anteh kaikhawm dingin khat pai a, amah in lo sungah vatak-um gui khat a mu hi. Amah in a gah pawlkhat kaikhawmin a puantual dimin a tun hi. A tun kik ciangin amaute in tuate bang hiam cih a theih loh uh hangin amah in meh beel sungah a atnen hi.
Mite nek dingin meh hong thukkhia uh a, ahih hangin amaute in nek ding a kipat uh ciangin amaute kiko-in, “Yahweh’ mipa aw, beel sungah sihna om hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ne thei lo uh hi.

Amah in, “Annel tawm khat hong paipih un,” a ci hi. Amah in beel sungah tua khahin, “Amaute in a nek theih nadingin mite kiangah va lui in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin beel sungah siatna bangmah a om nawn kei hi.

Tua khit ciangin Baal Shalisha panin mi khat hong tungin, Yahweh mipa kiangah anpal tawh kibawl anlum lum sawmnih leh ip sungah mangbuh-ham an thak hong paipih hi. Ylisha in, “Mite in a nek dingin amau kiangah pia in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a nasempa in, “Bang e? Mi zakhat mai-ah hih bangci lui ding i hi hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Mite in a nek dingin hihte lui in. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Amaute in ne-in khamval lai ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hi a, amah in amaute mai-ah koih a, tua ciangin amaute in ne-in Yahweh’ kammal mah bangin a khamval uh hi.

Tu-in Aram kumpipa’ galkap mangpa Naaman pen a kumpipa’ mit ah lianin a pahtawihuai mi khat ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ama tungtawnin Aram-te tungah gualzawhna a pia hi. Amah pen galhang khat hi a, ahih hangin miphak khat zong ahi hi.
Tu-in Aram mite kuankhia-in Israyl panin numeino khat man uh a, Naaman zi’ na a sem hi.
Tuanu in a pi kiangah, “Ka ukpa in Samaria gama om kamsangpa mu hi leh maw! A phaknatna panin amah dam ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Naaman pai-in ama kiangah, “Israyl gam panin hong pai numeino khat in tua bang tua bangin gen hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Aram kumpipa in, “Tu-in na pai in! Keimah in Israyl kumpipa kiangah lai ka khak ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in ngun talent sawm, kham shekel tulguk leh puansilh kop sawm a keng hi.
Amah in Israyl kumpipa kiangah laikhak pia-in, a sungah, “Hih laikhak hong sang in! En in, ka nasempa Naaman’ phak a dam theih nadingin nang kiangah amah kong sawl hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.

Israyl kumpipa in tua laikhak a sim khit phetin a puante balkek a, “Hih mipa a phak panin a dam nadingin kei kiang hong sawl zuzen keimah in thatin a hingsakkik thei pasian (el) khat ka hi hiam? A taktakin, en un hi bang liangin kei tawh kitot ding hahkat hi!” a ci hi.

Israyl kumpipa in a puante balkek hi, cih thu Yahweh’ mipa Ylisha in a zak ciangin, amah in kumpipa kiangah kamtai sawlin, “Bang hangin na puante balkek na hi hiam? Amah in Israyl sungah kamsang khat om hi, cih a theih nadingin ka kiangah amah hong paisak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a sakolte leh a leengte tawh Naaman pai-in, Ylisha’ inn kongkhak ah a khawl hi.
Ylisha in mi sawlin, “Pai inla Yardan ah sagihvei kisil in. Tua ciangin na cilesa a ngei bangin damkik ding a, nang na siang ding hi,” a cisak hi.

Ahih hangin Naaman a hehsuak mahmahin paikhia a, “Amah hong paikhia teekteekin ama pasian ahi Yahweh’ Min loin a natna mun tung tengah a khut van dingin ka mai-ah hong ding ding hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi!

Israyl gama tui khempeuh sangin Damascus gama Abanah leh Pharpar gunte hoihzaw hilo ahi hiam? Tuate ah kei kisilin siang thei lo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kihei-in hehsa-in a paikhia hi.

Tua ciangin ama kiangah a nasemte pai-in ama kiangah, “Ka pa aw, kamsangpa in na lianpi khatpeuh sem dingin hong sawl hileh sem ding hilo na hi hiam? Kisil ziau-in na sian nadingin nang hong gen ahih ciangin bangzah taka hih huaizaw tham lo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin amah paisukin, Yahweh’ mipa gensa bangin Yardan ah sagihvei kipap a, naupangnote cilesa bangin a cilesa a damkikin amah a siang hi.

Tua ciangin Naaman leh a nasemte khempeuh Yahweh’ mipa kiangah paikik uh hi. Amah tungin Ylisha mai-ah ding a, “Man taktak hi, Israyl sung lobuang ah pasian (el) khat beek a omloh lam tu-in ka thei hi! Tu-in na nasempa kiang panin letsong hong sang in!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ylisha in, “Ama na kasep Yahweh nungta taktak ahih mah bangin, bangmah kong sang kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Naaman in a san nadingin a kut tentan hangin ama’n a nial hi.

Tua ahih manin Naaman in, “Na nasempa tungah laa-sakol kop khat puak zawh leitang san hong pia in; bang hang hiam cihleh na nasempa in Yahweh kiang lobuang pasian (el) dang khatpeuh tungah meihal biakpiaknate leh biakpiaknate ka bawl ngei nawn kei ding hi.

Hih thu khat bek ah Yahweh in kei hong maisak tahen—Rimmon inn sungah a bia dingin ka kumpipa a pai ciangin amah ka khut tungah hong kingap ciangin kei zong Rimmon inn ah ka kun hi—Rimmon inn ah ka kun ciangin Yahweh in hih thu ah na nasempa hong maisak tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ylisha in ama kiangah, “Lungnuamin pai in!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in tua gam panin a gamlapi ah a zinkhia hi.

Ahih hangin Ylisha nasempa Gehazi in Yahweh’ mipa kiangah, “En in, ama hong puak letsongte sang loin ka ukpa in hih Aram mipa Naaman tungah na baihsak lua hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh nungta ahih mah bangin amah nungdelhin ama kiang panin khatpeuh ka ngah ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gehazi in Naaman a delhkik hi. Naaman in a nungah Gehazi hong tai a muh ciangin amah a dawn dingin a leeng tung panin tuakkhia-in, “Thu a hoihkim hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Amah in, “A vekpi-in hoih hi! Ka ukpa in kei hong sawlin a gen inah: ‘Ephraim mualtung gam panin kamsang pasal khangno nih tu mah deuhin kei kiangah hong tung hi. Nangmah in ngun talent khat leh puansilh kop nih amaute na pia thei ding hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Naaman in, “Talent nih la in!” a ci hi. Gehazi in tuate a sanna dingin kunh a, ip nih sungah ngun talent nih henin puansilh kop nih tawh a hen khawm hi. Amah in a nasem nihte tungah tuate pia-in amaute in Gehazi mai-ah tuate a pua uh hi.
Ophel; gal panna mual, ah amah a tun ciangin amaute’ khut panin tua nate la-in inn sungah a koih hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in tua mite ciahsakin amaute a paikhia uh hi.
Tu-in amah lutin a ukpa mai-ah ding a, Ylisha in ama kiangah, “Gehazi aw, koi ah pai na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Na nasempa koi mah ah ka pai kei hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Nang hong dawn dingin a sakolleeng tung panin mipa a kiheikik lai-in ka lungtang; thu theihna, nang tawh om hilo ahi hiam? Tuhun pen sum lak hun ahi hiam, ahih keileh puansilh, olive lote, leenggui lote, tuute, bawngtalte, nasem numei ahi a, nasem pasal ahi zongin lak ding hun ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Naaman phakna in nang leh na suanlekhakte a tawntungin hong bawl ding hi!” a ci hi. A omna panin Gehazi a paikhiat ciangin vuk bangin kangin amah a phak hi.
Kamsang honte in Ylisha kiangah, “En in, nang tawh i om khopna mun in kote aa dingin neulua hi.
Yardan ah ka pai ding uh hong phal inla, kote khat ciat in khuam khat ciat satin, i ten nading mun khat hong lamsak in,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Pai un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin khat in, “Na nasemte tawh nong pai khawm ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Kong pai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute tawh amah pai hi. Yardan ah amaute a tun uh ciangin singkungte a phuk uh hi.
Ahih hangin khat in sing a phuk laitakin tui sungah a heitang a kiasak hi. Amah in, “O, ka ukpa, a kikawm hiven!” ci-in a kiko hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mipa in, “Koi munah kia a hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in a kiatna mun a kawk hi. Tua ahih ciangin Ylisha in ciangkang khat khiak a, tua lai munah lawnin tua sik a laamtosak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “La to in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mipa in a khut zanin a la hi.
Tu-in Israyl tawh Aram kumpipa a kido hi. A uliante tawh amah kikumin, “Ka giahphual pen tua mun tua mun ah om ding hi,” ci-in a tangko hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mipa in Israyl kumpipa kiangah thu puakin, “Tua mun na nawk loh nading phawk in; bang hang hiam cihleh Aram mite tua lai-ah paisuk uh hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in Yahweh’ mipa genna mun teng a kansim hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ mipa in amah hilhkhol ahih manin tua lai-ah galging takin a om hi. Ylisha in kumpipa aa dingin hihsak zelzel hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-in Aram kumpipa a sinso hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a uliante samin, amaute kiangah, “Hong gen un, eite laka Israyl kumpipa lamah a pang kuapen hiam?” a ci hi.
A uliante khat in, “Ka uk kumpipa aw, kote khat beek ka hi kei uh hi! Ahih hangin na lupna inndei sunga na gen thute Israyl sunga kamsang Ylisha in Israyl kumpipa kiangah gen hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Pai un, amah a man ding mi ka sawl theih nadingin a omna mun va kan un!” ci-in thu a pia hi. Ama kiangah, “Dothan ah om hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua lai-ah a thahat galtha sakolte leh sakolleengte a sawl hi. Zanin amaute kuankhia-in khuapi a umcih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mipa’ nasempa thobaih-in a paikhiat ciangin sakolte leh sakolleengte tawh khuapi umcih-in galkapte na om hi. Nasempa in, “O, ka ukpa, bang cih mawk ding?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amah in, “Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute tawh a omte sangin ei tawh a omte tamzaw hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Ylisha in thungenin, “Yahweh aw, thu kong ngen hi; amah in a muh theih nadingin a mitte honsak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in tangvalpa’ mitte honsak a, Ylisha kiimkot khempeuh ah meikuang sakolte leh sakolleengte mualtung dimin a om a mu hi.

Ama lamah Aram-te a mainawt ciangin Ylisha in Yahweh kiangah thungenin, “Kong thuum hi; hih mite mittawtna tawh vat in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Amah in Ylisha’ thungetna bangin mittawtna tawh amaute a vat hi.

Tua ciangin Ylisha in amaute kiangah, “Hih pen lampi hi loin hih pen khuapi hilo hi. Kei hong zui un, na zon uh mipa kiangah kong paipih ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in Samaria ah amaute a paipih hi.

Samaria ah amaute a lut khit uh ciangin Ylisha in thungenin, “Yahweh aw, amaute in a muh theih nadingun hih mite mit honsak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in a mitte uh honsakin Samaria sunglam ah amaute a omna uh a mu uh hi!
Israyl kumpipa in amaute a muh ciangin amah in Ylisha kiangah, “Ka pa aw, amaute ka that ding hiam? Amaute ka that ding hiam?” a ci hi.

Amah in dawngin ama kiangah, “Amaute na that kei ding hi! Nangma namsau leh thal tawh salin na mat mite na that ding hiam? Amaute in ne-in dawnin a kumpipa kiangah a ciahkik theih nadingun amaute mai-ah an leh tui lui in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amaute aa dingin pawi lianpi khat kibawlsakin, amaute in a nek khit a dawn khit uh ciangin, amah in amaute sawlkhia a, a kumpipa kiangah amaute a ciah uh hi. Tua ahih manin Aram mi pawlte in Israyl gam va sim nawn lo uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Aram kumpipa Ben-Hadad in a galkap buppi kaikhawmin kuanto a, Samaria a umcih hi.
Samaria ah kialpi nasia takin om a, ngun shekel sawmgiatin laa’ lutang khat, ngun shekel nga-in vakhu’ ek cab khat seh-li-ah-khat a kizuak dongin amaute in khuapi umcih uh hi.
Israyl kumpipa kulhzang ah a pai laitakin numei khat ama tungah kiko-in, “Hong huh in, ka ukpa, ka kumpipa aw!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in nang hong huh kei leh, nang aa dingin huhna koi-ah hong zonsak thei ding ka hi hiam? Ancilna phual pan maw, ahih keileh leenggahtui sukna pan maw?” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Bang thu ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in, “Hih numeinu in kei kiangah, ‘Tuni-in na tapa i nek theih nadingin hong pia inla, zingciangin ka tapa i ne ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in ka tapa huanin ka ne uh hi. Tua khit a zingciangin keimah in ama kiangah, ‘Na tapa hong pia in; amah i ne ding hi,’ ka ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in a tapa na sel hi,” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in numeinu’ kammalte a zak ciangin a puante a balkek hi. Kulhzang ah amah a paipai laitakin mite in amah en a, amah in a pumpi tungah puan sungsilhin ippi puan a silh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Tuni-in Shaphat’ tapa Ylisha’ lutang ama tungah a omlai leh, Pasian (Elohim) in kei a ututin hong bawlin a nasiazaw-in zong hong hih tahen!” a ci hi.

Tua hunin Ylisha a inn sungah tu-in, amah tawh upate a tutkhop laitak uh ahi hi. Tu-in kumpipa in mi khat mapaisak hi; ahih hangin kamtaipa a tun ma-in Ylisha in upate kiangah, ‘Hih mithatpa in ka lutang a tankhia dingin mi khatpeuh a sawl lam na mu uh hiam? En un, kamtaipa hong tun ciangin kong khak unla, limtakin lencip un. Ama nungah a ukpa’ kheging hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Amaute tawh a kiho laitak mahin, kamtaipa ama kiangah hong tungsuk ta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in, “Hih samsiatna pen Yahweh kiang pan hi taktak ahih manin bang hangin Yahweh ngakngak lai nawn ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Ylisha in, “Yahweh’ kammal za in. Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Zingciang tuhun mahin annel seah khat ngun shekel khatin kizuak ding a, Samaria kulhkongpi ah mangbuh-ham seah nih pen shekel khatin kizuak ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a ban tungah kumpipa a kingapna ulianpa in Yahweh’ mipa kiangah, “En in, Yahweh in vantung ah tawlette a bawl phial hangin zong hih thu piang thei ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tu-in kulhkongpi lutna ah miphak li om a, amaute khat le khat kiho-in, “Sih ding ngakin bang hangin hih lai-ah tutu ding i hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Eite in, “Khuapi sungah i lut ding hi,” i cih hangin khuapi sungah kialpi tung a, tua lai-ah i si ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin pai un, Aram galkapte kiangah va ki-ap ni. Amaute in eite hong nuntaksak leh, i nungta ding a, amaute in hong thah uh leh, a si ding mah i hi lel hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Aram mite’ giahphual ah a pai dingin nitak nih kikalin amaute a kuankhia uh hi. Aram mite’ giahphual mongte a tun uh ciangin tua lai-ah mi khat beek a na om kei hi—

Bang hang hiam cihleh galkap honpi khat a pai bangin sakolleeng gingte leh sakol gingte Yahweh in Aram mite a zasak hi. Amaute khat le khat kigenin, “En un! Israyl kumpipa in eite hong do dingin Hit mite’ kumpite leh Egypt mite’ kumpite cialkhin hi!” a ci uh hi.

Hih thu hangin amaute dingin nitak nih kikalin taimang uh a, a om bangbangin a giahphual uh—a puanbukte, a sakolte, a laate uh a nusia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in a nuntak nadingin a taimang uh hi.

Giahphual mongte ah hih miphakte a tun uh ciangin puanbuk khat sungah lut a, ne-in a dawn uh hi. Tua panin amaute in ngun leh kham, puansilhte la a, paikhiatpihin a sel uh hi. Tua khit ciangin paikikin, puanbuk adang khat ah lutin, vante la-in tuate zong a sel uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin amaute khat le khat kiho-in, “A man bangin i gamta kei hi. Tuni pen a lungdamhuai thuzak ni hi a, daitakin i om mawk hi. Eite in zingsang khuavak dong ngak lehang, eite tungah dantatna pawlkhat hong tung thei ding hi. Tu-in ding un, eite pai-in kumpipa innkuanpihte zasak ni,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute pai-in, khuapi kulhkongpi a cingte samkhia-in amaute kiangah, “Aram mite’ giahphual ah ka pai uh a, tua lai-ah mi khat beek a om kei uh hi—khatpeuh’ huging zong kiza lo a, sakolte leh laate kikhih bekin, puanbukte a hi dandanin kinusia hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kongcingte in tua thu genkhia uh a, kumpipa’ inn a sunglam ah thu a puak uh hi.

Tua ciangin zanin kumpipa tho-in a uliante kiangah, “Syria mite in ei tungah hong hih sawm thu hong gensak dih un. Eite i gilkial lam amaute in thei uh a, tua ahih ciangin gamlak ah a bu dingin amaute in a giahphual uh nusia pak hi a, amaute in, ‘Khuapi sung panin hong paikhiat uh ciangin, amaute hingmatin, khuapi i la ding hi!’ ci uh hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin a uliante khat in, “Khuapi sunga a omlai sakolte lak panin nga, mi pawlkhat lasak ni. En in, amaute pen hih lai-a a nusiat uh Israyl a omlai khempeuh mah tawh a kibang ahi hi—hi hi, amaute pen a kinetum ding Israyl khempeuh mah bang lel ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang thu piang hiam cih a encian dingin amaute sawl ni,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in sakolleeng nih leh a sakolte tawh tengkhia uh a, kumpipa in Aram galkapte omna lamah tuate sawlin, “Pai un! Bang thu piang hiam cih hong encian un!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in Yardan ciang dong Aram mite nungzuih uh a, Aram mite in nawhsa taka a taikekna vua a paihmang uh puansilhte leh galvante lamdung buppi ah dimin a om a mu uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin kamtaite hong ciahkikin kumpipa kiang a gen uh hi.

Tua ciangin mite paikhia uh a, Aram mite’ puanbukte a luh uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ kammal a kigensa bang teekteekin annel seah khat pen ngun shekel khatin kizuak a, mangbuh-ham seah nih ciangin shekel khatin kizuak hi.

Tu-in kumpipa in a ban tunga amah a kingapna ulianpa pen kulhkongpi ah thunei-in koih a, mite in kulhkongzawi ah amah phupai-in tuancil uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ mipa inn ah kumpipa a paisuk lai-in Yahweh’ mipa gensa bang lianin amah si hi.

Yahweh’ mipa in kumpipa kiangah a gensa bang lianin hong piang hi: Zingciang tuhunin Samaria kulhkongpi ah annel seah khat pen shekel khatin kizuakin, mangbuh-ham seah nih ciangin ngun shekel nihin kizuak ding hi, ci hi.

Tua ciangin tua ulianpa in Yahweh’ mipa dawngin, ‘En in, Yahweh in vantung ah tawlette a bawl zongin, tua bangin piang ding ahi hiam?’ a ci zo hi. Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, “Nangma mit mahmah tawh na mu ding a, ahih hangin tuate na ne kha kei ding hi!” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua hi a, ama tungah tua bangin hong piang hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kulhkongpi ah mite in amah tuancilin amah a si hi.

Ylisha in a tapa nuntakna a ngahkik numei kiangah, “Nang leh na innkuanpihte paikhia un. Na om theihna peuhpeuh uh ah om un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kialpi tungsak a, gam sungah kum sagih sung omlai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin numeinu dingin, Yahweh’ mipa in amah a gensa bangin hih a, tuanu leh a innkuanpihte a paikhia uh hi. Philistia-te gam sungah amaute kum sagih sung a om uh hi.
Kum sagihna a bei ciangin Philistia-te gam panin numeinu a ciahkik hi. Tua ciangin amah in a inn leh a leitang a ngahkik nadingin kumpipa kiangah a ngen dingin a pai hi.
Yahweh’ mipa nasempa Gehazi tawh kumpipa kiho-in, “Ylisha bawlsa na lamdangte khempeuh hong gen in,” a ci hi.

Tu-in Ylisha tungtawnin a sisa khat a kinuntakkiksakna thu amah in kumpipa a gengen laitak teekteekin, a inn leh a leitang a ngahkik nadingin kumpipa kiangah a ngen dingin a pai numeinu a om hi. Gehazi in, “Ka ukpa, ka kumpipa aw, tua numeinu pen amah ahi hi! Tua a nuntakna a ngahkikpa pen ama tapa ahi hi!” a ci hi.

Kumpipa in tua thu numeinu kiang a dot ciangin tuanu in a gen hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in tuanu aa dingin ulian khat sehin, “Ama neihsa khempeuh piakik inla, hih gam a nusiat ni-a kipanin tuni donga a leitang pana kingah khempeuh zong pia in,” a ci hi.
Damascus ah Ylisha pai a, Aram kumpipa Ben-Hadad a ci a na hi. Ben-Hadad kiangah hih thu kigenin, “Hih lai-ah Yahweh’ mipa hong tung hi,” a kici hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Hazael kiangah, “Na khut sungah letsong khat tawi inla, Yahweh’ mipa tawh kimu dingin va pai in. Ama tungtawnin Yahweh kiang thu dong inla, ‘Hih natna panin ka damkik zo ding hiam,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah tawh a kimu dingin Hazael pai a, Damascus-a na hoih namkim kalaoh puak sawmli letsong a paipih hi. Amah tungin Ylisha mai-ah ding a, “Aram kumpipa na tapa Ben-Hadad in nang kiangah kei hong sawlin, ‘Hih natna panin ka damkik zo ding hiam,’ ci-in hong dongsak hi,” a ci hi.
Ylisha in ama kiangah, “Pai inla, ama kiangah gen in: Na damkik taktak ding hi. Ahih hangin amah a si taktak ding hi, cih thu Yahweh in kei tungah hong pulaak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Hazael a maizum dongin Ylisha in enin sal gega a, tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ mipa kah ding a kipan hi.

Hazael in, “Bang hangin ka ukpa kap na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite tungah na natsak ding leh na suksiat ding ka thei hi—amau khuapi muanhuaite nangmah in mei tawh na halin, a khanglaite namsau tawh thatin, a naupangte uh leilak ah na thatang denna ding a, a nupi naupaiite uh na phelsuah ding lam ka thei hang ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Hazael in, “Na nasempa bang hi a, ui a bang lel khat ahi hi! Bang hangin hih bang na lianpite sem thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Ylisha in, “Aram-te tungah kumpi na suah ding lam Yahweh in kei hong lakkhin hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in Ylisha nusia-in a kumpipa kiangah ciahkik a, kumpipa in, “Ylisha in nang tungah bang thu hong gen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Amah in na damkik taktak ding hi, ci-in hong gen hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a zingciangin Hazael in puan sahpi khat la-in tui lakah diah a, tua tawh Ben-Hadad a sih dongin a maitang a tuamcip hi. Tua khit ciangin Hazael in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Israyl kumpipa Ahab’ tapa Yahram’ uk zawh a kum ngana kumin Yahshaphat’ tapa Yahram in Yahdah kumpi-in uk ding kipan hi.
Amah kumpi a suahin kum 32 pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum giat uk hi.
Ahab innkuan gamtat bang teekteekin Israyl kumpite lampi amah in zui hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Ahab’ tanu pen a zi hi a, Yahweh mit ah a sia-in gamta hi.
Tua hi napi-in Yahweh in a nasempa David a cihna hangin Yahdah susia lo hi—Amah in David leh a suanlekhak tungah a tawntungin meivak khat a piak ding ciamkhin hi.
Ama uk hun sungin Edom in Yahdah lehdo-in, amau tungah kumpi khat a sehtawm uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Zair ah amah leh a sakolleengte khempeuh tawh Yahram a pai hi. Edom mite in amah umcihin amah leh a sakolleeng ukte khempeuh a do hi. Ahi zongin amah kipanin zanin a phulet a, a mite inn ah a tai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Edom in Yahdah a lehdo uh hi. Tua hun mahin Libnah in a langdo hi.
Tu-in Yahdah-a Yahram’ uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh a sep khempeuh Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua hi a Yahram a pate tawh ihmu-in, David Khuapi ah a pate tawh a kivui hi. Tua khit ciangin Ahazyah; Achatzyah, in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Israyl kumpipa Ahab’ tapa Yahram’ uk zawh a kum sawm le nih kumin Yahram’ tapa Ahazyah in Yahdah kumpi-in uk ding a kipan hi.
Ahazyah kumpi a suahin amah kum sawm nih le nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum khat a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Athalyah hi a, Israyl kumpipa Omri’ tunu ahi hi.
Amah in Ahab innkuan lampi mah zui-in Ahab innkuan gamtat bang teekteekin Yahweh mit ah a sia-in a gamta hi—bang hang hiam cihleh amah in kitenna tungtawnin Ahab innkuan tawh a kitanau hi.
Tu-in Aram kumpipa Hazael sim dingin Ramoth Gilead ah Ahab’ tapa Israyl-a Yahram tawh Ahazyah kuan khawm hi; tua ciangin Aram mite in Yahram a liamsak uh hi.

Tua ciangin amah in Aram kumpipa Hazael a sim lai-in, Ramoth Gilead ah Aram mite in amah a liamsakna liammate panin a dam nadingin Yezreel ah kumpi Yahram a ciahkik hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahram liam ahih manin Yahdah kumpipa ahi Yahram’ tapa Ahazyah in Yezreel ah Israyl kumpipa Ahab’ tapa Yahram a en dingin a pai hi.
Kamsang Ylisha in kamsang pasalte khat samin ama kiangah, “Na kawngah na puante zep inla, na khut sungah hih sathau biing la-in Ramoth Gilead pai in.
Tua teng mun na tun ciangin Nimshi’ tapa Yahshaphat’ tapa Yahu zong in. Ama kiangah pai inla, a lawmte kiang panin paikhiatpihin inndei tuam khat ah amah paipih in.

Tua khit ciangin sathau biing la-in a lu tungah sung inla, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Israyl tungah kumpi-in nang sathau kong nilhzo hi!’ ci hi,’ ci in. Tua khit ciangin kongkhak hong inla tai in—zekai kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ramoth Gilead ah kamsang tangvalpa a pai hi.

Amah a tun ciangin galkap uliante a tu khawm uh a mu hi. Amah in, “Galkap mangpa aw, nang aa dingin gen ding thu khat ka nei hi,” a ci hi. Yahu in ama kiangah, “Kote laka kua pen aa ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Nang aa ding hi, mangpa aw,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah dingto-in inn sungah a lut hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in Yahu’ lu tungah sathau sungin ama kiangah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Keimah in Yahweh’ mite ahi Israyl-te tungah kumpi-in nangmah sathau kong nilh hi.
Nangmah in tu laitakin a uk Ahab innkuan na susia ding a, tua ciangin Yezebel’ khut hanga a luang ka nasem kamsangte’ sisan leh Yahweh’ nasemte khempeuh’ sisan phu ka la ding hi.
Ahab innkuan buppi si ding a, sila ahi a, sila lo ahi zongin Israyl sunga Ahab’ gui pasal khempeuh ka beisak ding hi.
Keimah in Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam innkuan leh Ahiyah’ tapa Baasha innkuan bangin Ahab innkuan ka bawl ding hi.
Uite in Yezreel-a leitual neu khat ah Yezebel ne ding uh a, kuamah in tuanu vui lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in kongkhak hongin, a tai hi.

Kumpipa’ uliante kiangah Yahu a paikik ciangin amaute laka khat in, “Thu hoih ahi hiam? Bang hangin hih mihaipa nang kiangah hong pai ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in amaute kiangah, “Mipa leh a genkhiatte na thei uh hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in, “Tua bel man kei ei! Tu-in hong gen in!” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Ama hong gen hih bang ahi hi: ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Keimah in Israyl tungah kumpi-in nang sathau kong nilh hi,’ ci hi,’ ci-in hong gen hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin a mikimun nawhtatin, a puante uh suah khia a, kahlei tungah ama pai nading ah tuate a phah hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute in peengkul muutin, “Yahu kumpi ahi hi!” ci-in a tangko uh hi.
Tua ciangin Nimshi’ tapa Yahshaphat’ tapa Yahu in Yahram a sawmsim hi. (Tu-in Yahram leh Israyl khempeuh in Ramoth Gilead ah Aram kumpipa Hazael a langpan uh hi.

Ahih hangin Aram kumpipa Hazael tawh a sim lai-a Aram mite in amah a liamsak liamma panin a damkik nadingin Yezreel ah a ciahkik kul hi.) Yahu in, “Hih thu pen nang deihna leh na lunggulh ahih leh, Yezreel ah thuthak a gen dingin khuapi panin khatpeuh a paikhiat ding phal kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahu in Yezreel ah sakolleeng khat tuangin pai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai-ah Yahram tha lakik a, amah a en dingin Yahdah kumpipa Ahazyah a paisuk hi.

Yezreel-a tausang tungah galvilpa ding a, amah in Yahu’ pawlte a hong pailam a muh ciangin amah kiko-in, “Mihon khat ka mu hi!” a ci hi. Yahram in, “Sakol tuang khat sam inla, amaute dawn dingin sawlkhia in. Amah in, ‘Thu hoihin hong pai na hi uh hiam?’ cisak in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah dawn dingin sakol tuangpa hong pai-in, “Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Thu hoihin hong pai na hi uh hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Yahu in ama kiangah, “Thu hoih tawh bang cih ding na hi hiam? Kihei inla, ka nung ah hong zui in!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin galvilpa in, “Amau kiangah kamtaipa tung a, ahih hangin amah hong kilehkik lo hi,” ci-in a zasak hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in sakol tuang a nihna sawlkhia-in, “Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Thu hoihin hong pai na hi uh hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahu in, “Thu hoih tawh bang cih ding na hi hiam? Kihei inla, ka nung ah hong zui in,” a ci hi.

Galvilpa in, “Amau kiangah amah tung napi-in amah hong kilehkik tuan lo hi, tua banah a hawldan pen Nimshi’ tapa Yahu hawldan tawh kibang hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in mihai bangin hawlgawp hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahram in, “Ka sakolleeng hong la un!” ci-in thu a pia hi. A sakolleeng a kithawi khit ciangin Israyl kumpipa Yahram leh Yahdah kumpipa Ahazyah a nih tuakun amau sakolleeng ciat tawh a paikhia uh hi. Yahu dawn dingin amau paikhia uh a, Yezreel mi Naboth’ neihsa leitang leitual neu mun ah amah tawh a kituak uh hi.

Yahram in Yahu a muh ciangin amah in, “Thu hoihin hong pai na hi hiam, Yahu?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Na nu’ pasian-biakna (elohim biakna) leh a aisannate tawh a kidim laisiah bang thu hoih om ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahram kihei-in tai a, Ahazyah otsan kawmin, “Ahazyah aw, hong kilehhek ei!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahu in a tha neih zahin a thal kekin Yahram’ liangko nih kikal a kap hi. A lungtang ah thaltang lutin, a sakolleeng tungah a tuksuk pah hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahu in a ulianpa Bidkar thupia-in, “Amah tawm inla Yezreel mi Naboth neihsa leitang hih leitual neu ah pai in. Nang leh kei in a pa Ahab nungah leeng i tuan lai-in Yahweh in ama tungah hih dantatna thu a genna phawk in:

‘Zanni-in Naboth’ sisan leh a tapate’ sisan ka mu taktak hi,’ Yahweh in ci hi. ‘Tua ciangin hih leitual neu sungah tua hangin nang kong thukkik taktak ding hi,’ Yahweh in ci hi. Tu-in amah tawm inla, Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in tua leitual neu ah amah pai in!” a ci hi.

Yahdah kumpi Ahazyah in bang teng piang hiam cih a theih ciangin huan inn kianga lampi ah a taimang hi. Yahu in amah nungdelhin, kiko a, “Amah zong that un!” a ci hi. Amaute in Ibleam nai-a Gur lam tuahsukna mun a sakolleeng tungah amah liamsak uh hi; ahih hangin Megiddo ah amah suakta-in tua lai-ah a si hi.
A uliante in sakolleeng khat tawh Yerusalem ah pua a, David Khuapi ama han ah a pate tawh a kivui khawm hi.
Ahab’ tapa Yahram’ ukzawh a kum sawm le khat kumin, Yahdah tungah Ahazyah kumpi hikhin hi.
Tua ciangin Yezreel ah Yahu a tung hi. Yezebel a kizaksak ciangin amah in a mitte zutin a sam bawl a, tua khit ciangin tawlet panin a dakkhia hi.
Kulhkongpi tawnin Yahu hong lut lian laitakin, tuanu kiko-in, “Nang ma-a kumpipa a that Zimri zong thu hoihsuak sa na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahu in tawlet ento-in, “Kei lamah kua pang na hi uh hiam? Kua?” ci-in a otsan hi. Tua ciangin cilgeh innsung mang nih le thum in a ensuk hi.

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Tuanu hong lawnsuk un!” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tuanu lawnsuk a, amah in tuanu tuancil gawp ahih manin tuanu’ sisan kimkhat kulh tung leh sakolte tungah a kitheh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah a sungah lutin an ne-in tui a dawn hi. Tua zawh ciangin amah in, “Tu-in pai un, samsiatna a thuak tua numeinu don un. Amah pen kumpipa’ tanu ahih ciangin amah vui un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuanu a vei dingin amaute paikhia uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in a luguh, a khete leh a khut bomte lobuang bangmah dang a mu kei uh hi.

Amaute hong paikikin hih thu Yahu a gen uh hi. Amah in, “Hih zong Yahweh in a nasempa Tishbi mi Yliyah tungah, ‘Yezreel-a leitual neu ah uite in Yezebel’ satak ne ding uh hi,’ ci-in a gensa Yahweh’ kammal mah hi a,
Yezreel-a leitual neu-a leilak ah Yezebel’ pumpi nin kipaai tawh kibang ding hi; tua ahih ciangin kuamah in, ‘Hih lai-ah Yezebel kisial hi,’ ci thei lo ding uh hi,’ ci-in a gen ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tu-in Samaria ah Ahab innkuan ta pasal sawm sagih a om hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahu in laikhak gelhin, Yezreel-a ukpite kiang, upate kiang leh Ahab’ tapate khansuahin a cingte khempeuh kiang Samaria ah amaute sawlin, a gen inah:
“Note in sakolleengte, sakolte, khuapi muanhuaite, leh galvante nei-in note tawh kumpipa’ tapate om khawm ahih nungsangin hih laikhak na ngah phetun,
kumpipa’ tapate lak panin a kicingtakpen leh a kilawmpen khat teel unla, a pa’ kumpi-tokhom luahsak unla, tua ciangin na kumpi-inn aa dingin galdo dingin kithawi un!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute lau lua mahmahin, “En un, kumpi nih in amah nang zo lo ahih uh leh, bang hangin eite in nang zo ding i hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin inn sung thu vaihawmpa, khua sung ukpa leh a upate, leh kumpipa’ tapate a cingte khempeuh in Yahu kiangah kamtai sawlin, “Na nasemte ka hi uh hi. Nong gen bangin ka sem ding uh hi; ahih hangin kote in khatpeuh kumpi a suaksak kei ding uh hi. Nang muhna ah man na sak bangin sem in,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute kiangah laikhak nihna gelhin, “Note pen kei aa ding na hih uh a, ka thu nong man ding uh leh, kumpipa’ tapate lutang lakhia-in zingciang tu bang hunin Yezreel-a kei kiangah hong pai un!” a ci hi. Tu-in kumpipa’ innkuan-a tapa mi sawm sagihte pen amau a khansuah khuapi sunga mi makaite tawh a om uh hi.
Amau kiangah laikhak a tun phetin, amaute in kumpipa’ tapate manin, mi sawm sagih a thatlum uh hi. Amaute in a lutangte bawm sungah guangin Yezreel-a Yahu kiangah tuate a puak uh hi.

Tua ciangin kamtai khat hong tungin, ama kiangah, “Amaute in kumpipa’ tapate lutangte hong paipih uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Zingsang dongin khuapi kulhkongpi lutna ah lom nihin koih un,” a ci hi.
A zingciang zingsangin amah paikhia-in mi khempeuh kiangah thu genin, “Note na mawhpeng uh hi! En un, keimah in ka ukpa sawmsimin, amah ka that lum hi; ahih hangin hihte khempeuh kua thah ahi hiam?
Yahweh in Ahab innkuan langpanin a gensa Yahweh’ kammal khat zong a kipelh loh ding lam tu-in thei un. Yahweh in a nasempa Yliyah tunga a ciamsa bangin semkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahu in Yezreel-a Ahab innkuan a omlai khempeuh, ama uliante, a kilawmtatpihte leh a siampite, khat beek zong a om nawn loh dongin a that hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahu paikhia-in Samaria ah a pai hi. Lamkal-a Tuucingte omna Beth Eked; Tuumul-metna Inn, ah,

amah in Yahdah kumpipa Ahazyah’ kinaipih pawlkhat tuak a, “Kuate na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “Ahazyah’ sanggam pasalte ka hi uh hi. Kote in kumpinu’ tapate leh kumpipa’ tapa dangte hopih dinga hong paisuk ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Yahu in, “A hingin man un!” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a hingin manin tua khit ciangin Beth Eked-a tuikhuk ah amaute mihing sawm li le nih a that uh hi. Amah in khat beek a hingkhawi kei hi.

Tua mun a nusiat ciangin amah a dawn dingin a pai Rechab’ tapa Yahnadab tawh a kituak hi. Yahu in amah hopihin, “Nang tunga ka lungkim bangin kei tungah na lungkim hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Yahnadab in, “Ka lungkim hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Yahu in, “Tua ahih leh, na khut hong khak in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut khakin, Yahu in ama sakolleeng sungah a kaito hi.
Yahu in, “Kei hong zui inla, Yahweh aa dingin ka thalawpna hong mu in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a sakolleeng sungah a tuangsak hi.
Samaria ah a tun ciangin amah in Samaria-a Ahab innkuan a omlaite khempeuh a that hi. Yahweh in Yliyah tunga a gensa Ama kammal tawh kizui-in amah in amaute a susia hi.
Tua ciangin Yahu in mipi khempeuh kaikhawmin amaute kiangah, “Ahab in Baal’ na tawmno sem hi! Yahu in tampi a sem ding hi!

Tu-in Baal kamsangte khempeuh—a thugente khempeuh leh a siampite khempeuh kei kiangah hong sam un. Baal aa dingin biakpiakna lianpi khat nei ding ka hih manin khat beek a pelem loh nadingin hih un! A pelem peuhmah nungta lo ding hi!” a ci hi. Yahu in Baal kiangah na a semte a suksiat theih nadingin a kineih-khem ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yahu in, “Baal aa dingin a thupi kikhopna khat bawl un!” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a tangko uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahu in Israyl sung khempeuh ah kamtaite sawlin, tua ciangin Baal nasemte khempeuh hong pai uh hi. A pailo khat beek a om kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin Baal Inn sungah amaute lutin, tua ciangin Baal Inn a mong khat pan a mong khat dong a dim hi.

Tua ciangin amah in puankoihna-a thuneipa kiangah, “Baal aa dingin biaknasep a sem khempeuh aa dingin puantualpite hong lakhia in!” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute aa dingin puantualpite a lakhia hi.

Tua ciangin Baal Inn sungah Yahu leh Rechab’ tapa Yahnadab lutin, Baal biaknasemte kiangah, “Hih lai-ah note tawh Yahweh’ nasem khat beek om loin Baal biaknasemte bek a om nadingin sittel un!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin biakpiaknate leh meihal biaknate a pia dingin amaute lut uh hi. Tu-in Yahu in a pualam ah pasal sawm giat mun lasakin amaute kiangah, “Na khut sung uha kong koihsa mite khatpeuh a suakta na omsak uh leh, ama nuntakna tangin nang nuntakna hi ding hi,” ci-in thu a pia hi.

Amah in meihal biakpiakna a piak khit phetin Yahu in a ukte leh a cingte thupia-in, “Lut un! Amaute that unla kuamah suaktasak kei un!” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in namsau hiam tawh amaute that uh hi. A ukte leh a cingte in a luanghawmte lawmkhia-in, tua khit ciangin Baal Inn sungnung bukneu sungah lut uh hi.
Amaute in Baal Inn panin a siangtho suangtum; massebah, puakhia-in a hal uh hi.
Amaute in Baal etsakna tua a siangtho suangtum; massebah, susia-in, Baal Inn phelkek uh a, mite in tuni dongin ekbukin zang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahu in Israyl sung panin Baal a susia hi.
Ahi zongin Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialsak mawhna ahi Beth-El leh Dan-a kham biaknatau a kualte panin Yahu a kihei kei hi.

Yahweh in Yahu kiangah, “Nangmah in keima mit ah a man thu hoih takin semin, sep dinga Ka lungsima om khempeuh nangmah in Ahab innkuan langpanin zo siang na hih manin, Israyl kumpi-tokhom tungah khang lina dong na tu ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua hi napi-in Yahu in Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh’ Thukham a lungsim khempeuh tawh zuih ding a kidawm kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate, ama’n a taisan kei hi.
Tua hun ciangin Yahweh in Israyl gamgi khiap ding a kipan hi. Hazael in Israyl mite a tenna khempeuh ah zo a,
Yardan panin ni suahna lam dong— Arnon Gun kianga om Aroer panin Gilead gam leh Bashan gam a kihel Gilead gam khempeuh (Gad, Reuben leh Menasheh-te tenna) ahi hi.
Tu-in Yahu uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama sep khempeuh leh a vangliatna khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Yahu a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in Samaria ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Yahahaz; Yahachatz, in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Samaria panin Israyl-te tungah Yahu in a uk hun pen kum sawmnih le kum giat ahi hi.
Ahazyah’ nu Athalyah in a tapa si hi, cih a muh ciangin amah in a tupate nangawn kihelin kumpi gamluahte khempeuh susia dingin a kipan hi.

Ahih hangin thah dinga a kikoih kumpipa’ tapate lak panin Yahash pen kumpi Yahram’ tanu Ahazyah’ sanggamnu Yahsheba in a honkhia hi. Tuanu in a lupna inndei sungah amah a cingnu tawh kemin, amah a kithah loh nadingin Athalyah kiang panin a sel hi.
Athalyah in gam a uk hun sungin tuanu tawh Yahweh’ Inn sungah kum guk sung amah a kisel hi.

A kum sagihna kumin Yahyada in za khat ukte, Chereth mite leh inn cingte kiang mi sawlin, Yahweh’ Inn-a ama kiangah a kipaisak hi. Amah in amaute tawh thuciamna lai khat bawlin, Yahweh’ Inn ah amaute a kiciamsak hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in kumpipa’ tapa a lak hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, “Hih in na hihzia ding uh ahi hi: Shabbat ni-a sep ding tavuan a nei note lak panin seh-thum-ah-seh-khat in kumpi-inn na cing ding uh a,
seh-thum-ah-seh-khat in Sur Khulhkongpi cingin, seh-thum-ah-seh-khat in kumpi-inncingte nunga kulhkongpi ah mun a la ding uh hi.
Shabbat ni-a sep ding tavuan a om lo adang pawl nihte sunga note in kumpipa aa dingin Yahweh’ Inn na cing ding uh ahi hi.

Mi kim in a khut ah galhiam tawi-in kumpipa kiimkotah mun la tawm un. No lamah hong mainawt peuhpeuh na that ding uh hi. Kumpipa a pusuah ciang hitaleh a sungtum ciang hitaleh kumpipa tawh na om khawm ding uh hi,” ci-in a hilh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin za khat ukte in siampi Yahyada thupiak khempeuh a hih uh hi. Amaute khempeuh in Shabbat ni-a tavuan a neite hitaleh Shabbat ni-a tavuan a nei lote hitaleh a mite uh samin, siampi lian Yahyada kiangah a pai uh hi.
Siampipa in za khat ukpa kiangah Yahweh’ Inn-a om Kumpi David’ leipite leh lumte a pia hi.
Tua ciangin a khut sungah a galhiam ciat uh tawi-in biaknatau leh Yahweh’ Inn kikal, leilu lam leh leitaw lam, kumpipa kiimkot khempeuh ah mun a la uh hi.

Yahyada in kumpipa’ tapa paikhiatpihin, a lu tungah kumpi-lukhu khusak a, Thuciamna Laibu amah pia-in kumpi-in amah a tangko hi. Amaute in amah sathau nilhin mite in a khut uh beengin, “Kumpipa khansau tahen,” ci-in a awng uh hi.
Athalyah in inncingte leh mipite husa a zak ciangin Yahweh’ Inn-a mite kiangah a pai hi.

Amah a khuadak ciangin a ngeina tawh kizui-in khuampi gei-ah kumpipa a ding a mu hi. Kumpipa kiangah uliante leh peengkul tumte om a, tua gama mi khempeuh lungdamin peengkul a tum uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Athalyah in a puante balkekin, “Sawmsimna! Sawmsimna!” ci-in a kiko hi.

Siampi Yahyada in za khat ukte, galkap uliante thupia-in, “A cingte omna pan lakhia un! Tuanu a zui khempeuh that un!” a ci hi. (Bang hang hiam cihleh siampipa in “Yahweh’ Inn ah tuanu a kithat kei ding hi,” a cizo hi.)
Kumpipa inna sakolte a lutna munah tuanu a tun laitakin amaute in amah manin, tua lai-ah amah a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mite a hih nadingin Yahyada in Yahweh, kumpipa leh a mite kikalah thuciamna khat bawl a, kumpipa leh mipite kikalah zong thuciamna khat a bawl hi.

Tua gama mi khempeuh Baal Inn ah pai-in a phelkek uh hi. Amaute in a biaknataute leh a milimte suzanin, biaknataute mai-ah Baal siampi Mattan a that uh hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa in Yahweh’ Inn cingte a koih hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in za khat ukte, Chereth mite, inncingte leh tua gama mite khempeuh sam a, amaute khempeuh in Yahweh’ Inn panin inncingte kulhkongpi ah lutin kumpi-innsungah kumpipa paipihsuk uh hi. Tua lai-ah amah kumpite’ tokhom tungah a tu hi.
Tua gama mi khempeuh lungdam nuam uh a, ahih hangin khuapi-a mite a dai uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpi-inn nai-ah namsau tawh Athalyah a kithat hi.
Yahash kumpi a suahin amah kum sagih pha hi.
Yahu uk zawh a kum sagihna kumin, Yahash kumpi suak a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum 40 sung uk hi. A nu’ min pen Zibiah hi a, Beersheba pan ahi hi.
Siampi Yahyada in amah a lamlah hun sung khempeuh Yahweh’ mit ah Yahash a manin gamta hi;
Ahih hangin mun sangte kihemkhia lo a, mite in mun sangte tungah biakpiakna leh paknamtui halna zomlai uh hi.

Yahash in siampite kiangah, “Yahweh’ Inn sunga a kilutpih a ki-ap letsongte panin sum khempeuh ahi mi kisim huna sumte, mimal kiciamna pana kingah sumte leh uttawmna hanga biaknate aa dinga a kipia sumte, Yahweh’ Inn ah paipih un.
Van manpha koihna panin siampite in hihte sangin, Yahweh’ Inn a siatna a kimuhna peuhpeuh puah uh hen,” a ci hi.
Kumpi Yahash uk zawh a kum sawmnih le kum thumna kum dong siampite in Yahweh’ Inn-a a siatnate a puah nai kei uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Yahash in Siampi Lian Yahyada leh siampi ngeinate samin, “Bang hangin Yahweh’ Inn-a a siatnate puah lo na hi uh hiam? Tu-in na mite kiang panun sum na la nawn kei unla, Yahweh’ Inn-a a siatnate puah nadingin pia un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin sum lak nawn loh nading leh Yahweh’ Inn-a a siatnate amau mah in a puah nawn loh ding uh siampi ngeinate a thukim uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Siampi Lian Yahyada in singkuang khat la-in a siin ah a vang bawl a, Yahweh’ Inn sung lutna a taklam panga biaknatau gei-ah a koih hi. Kongkhak a cing siampite in Yahweh’ Inn-a a kipaipih sumte khempeuh tua singkuang sungah a koih uh hi.
Amaute in singkuang sungah sum tampitak om cih a theih peuhpeuh ciangin, kumpipa’ lai-atpa leh Siampi Lianpa hong pai-in ip sungah guangin Yahweh’ Inn pana kingah sumte a sim uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in Yahweh’ Inn-a nasem dinga kiseh mite a ukte’ khut sungah a simsa uh sumte a pia uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn-a nasem khutsiamte leh innlamte tung,
leilesuang innlam siamte leh suangseekte tungah Yahweh’ Inn-a a siatna puah nadingin pia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate khempeuh pen Yahweh’ Inn puah nadingin a kipia ahi hi.

Yahweh’ Inn sungah a kipuak sumte pen ngun tuikuangte, mei-am tehna taitehte, tui thehna thawl gongbakte, peengkulte ahi a, Yahweh’ Inn aa dinga ngun leh kham nazat adang khatpeuh bawl nadingin kizang lo hi.
Tua pen Yahweh’ Inn a puah nasemte tung bek ah kipia hi.
Tua banah amaute in thumaan tintenin nasem uh ahih manin nasemte a piak dingin sum a apna mite kiang panin sum sazian zong a ngen kei uh hi.
Gamtat khialhna hanga biaknate pana sumte leh mawhna hanga biaknate pana sumte pen Yahweh’ Inn sungah kipuak a, tuate siampite aa ahi hi.
Aram kumpipa Hazael kuanto a, Gath do-in a la hi. Tua ahih ciangin Hazael in Yerusalem do dingin a khensat hi.

Ahih hangin Yahdah kumpi Yahash in a pate, Yahshaphat, Yahram leh Ahazyah, Yahdah kumpite’ apsa a siangtho nate khempeuh leh amahmah aa ahi a siangtho nate, Yahweh’ Inn sunga leh kumpi inna van manpha koihnate-a kham a muh khempeuh la-in, Aram kumpipa Hazael kiangah tuate puak a, tua ciangin Yerusalem panin Hazael a nungkik hi.
Tu-in Yahash uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama sep khempeuh, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
A uliante lak mah panin kipanin, sawmsimna khat vaihawm uh hi. Amaute in Silla paisukna lampi Beth Millo ah Yahash a that uh hi.

A uliante ahi Shimeath’ tapa Yahzachar leh Shomer’ tapa Yahzabad in amah sattuk uh hi. Amah si a, David Khuapi ah a pate tawh a kivui hi; tua ciangin a tapa Amazyah; Amatzyah, in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Ahazyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yahash uk zawh a kum sawmnih le kum thumna kumin Samaria ah Yahu’ tapa Yahahaz Israyl kumpi suakin kum sawm le kum sagih a uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta a, Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate a zui hi. Tuate panin amah a kiheikhia kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl-te tungah Yahweh heh a, Amah in amau nuntak sung tawntungin Aram kumpipa Hazael khut sung leh Hazael’ tapa Ben-Hadad khut sungah a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Yahahaz in Yahweh thuum ngeungau a, Yahweh in ama thu ngai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in Israyl a kinengngiamna a mu hi; ahang in Aram kumpipa in amaute a nengniam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Israyl-te kiangah honpa khat pia a, Aram mite khut sung panin amaute a suakta uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin nidanga a om ngei bangun Israyl mite a inn uh ah a teng uh hi.
Ahi zongin Yeroboam innkuan in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate panin amaute a kiheikhia tuan kei uh hi. Tuate mah zui lai-in, Samaria ah Asherah Khuampi zong a ding lai hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in sakol tung tuang sawmnga, sakolleeng sawm leh khe galkap tul sawm lobuang galkap sungah bangmah dang a nusiat kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Aram kumpipa in amaute susia-in ancil huna leivui bangin a bawl hi.
Tu-in Yahahaz uk hun sunga thupiang a omlai teng, a sep khempeuh leh a vangliatna-te Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Yahahaz a pate tawh ihmu a, Samaria ah amaute in amah a vui uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Yahash in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Yahash uk zawh a kum sawmthum le sagihna kumin, Yahahaz’ tapa Yahash pen Samaria ah Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in kum sawm le kum guk a uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate khatpeuh panin amah kiheikhia loin tuate mah a zui suak hi.
Tu-in Yahash uk sunga thupiang a omlai teng, a sepsa khempeuh leh Yahdah kumpipa Amazyah a dona-a a vangliatnate, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in Yahash a pate tawh ihmu a, ama kumpi-tokhom tungah Yeroboam a tu hi. Samaria ah Israyl kumpite tawh Yahash a kivui khawm hi.

Tu-in a sih nadingin natna tawh Ylisha a ci hong na ta hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama kiangah Israyl kumpi Yahash paisuk-in kah a, “Israyl-te leengte leh sakol tungtuangte; Israyl-te huhpa, ka pa, ka pa aw!” a ci hi.
Ylisha in ama kiangah, “Thal leh thaltang pawlkhat hong la in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in thal leh thaltang pawlkhat a la hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Israyl kumpipa kiangah, “Na khut sungah na thal tawi in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a khut sungah a thal tawi a, Ylisha in kumpipa’ khutte tungah ama khutte mahmah a nga hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Ni suahna lam tawlet hong in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama’n a hong hi. Tua khit ciangin Ylisha in, “Kap in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a kap hi. Tua khit ciangin Ylisha in, “Hih in Aram-te kiang pana hotkhiatna thaltang, Yahweh’ hotkhiatna thaltang ahi hi! Tu-in nangmah in Aphek ah Aram-te na susia siang kiuhkeuh ding hi!” ci-in a genkhia hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Thaltangte la in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama’n a la hi. Amah in kumpipa kiangah, “Tuate tawh leilak sat in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama’n thumvei sat-in tua khit ciangin a khawl hi.

Yahweh’ mipa ama tungah heh a, “Ngavei gukvei bang na sat ding hiven! Tua ciangin nangmah in Aram na suksiat siang kiuhkeuh dongin amah na sattuk ding hi! Ahih hangin tu-in nangmah in amah thumvei bek na zo ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ylisha si a, amaute in amah a vui uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Moab mi a buluh vatte in khuakhal hun sungin tua gam luh uh a,

Israyl-te in mi khat a vui laitakun, thakhat thu-in mi a buhluh vatte mu uh ahih manin amaute in Ylisha’ han sungah mipa’ luanghawm a lawn uh hi. Tua siluang in Ylisha’ guhte a sukkhak ciangin mipa hingkikin a khe-in a ding hi.
Aram kumpi Hazael in Yahahaz uk hun sungin Israyl a nengniam hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tawh a thuciamna hangin Amah pen amaute aa dingin hehpihna tawh kidimin amaute khual mahmahin, amaute awlmawh a, amaute susia nai loin, Ama kiang panin zong a paaikhia kei hi.
Tu-in Aram kumpi Hazael si-in a tapa Ben-Hadad in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.

Tua ciangin Hazael in a pa Yahahaz kiang panin gal sunga a laksak khuapite Yahahaz’ tapa Yahash in Hazael’ tapa Ben-Hadad kiang panin a mankik hi. Thumvei Yahash in amah zo a, Israyl khuapite a lakik hi.
Yahahaz’ tapa Yahash uk zawh a kum nihna kumin Yahash’ tapa Amazyah pen Yahdah kumpi a suak hi.
Kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih le kum nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnih le kum kua a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Yahaddan hi a, Yerusalem pan ahi hi.
A pa David gamtatsa a bat zawh loh hangin Yahweh mit ah amah a manin a gamta hi. Amah in a pa hihsa na khempeuh sepna tawh a pa Yahash lamlahna a zui hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mun sangte kilakhia lo hi. Mite in mun sangte tungah biakpiakna pia-in paknamtui hal lai uh hi.
Tua ciangin ama khut sungah kumpigam a kiphuhkip phetin, amah in kumpipa ahi a pa a that uliante a that hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in thupia-in, “Tate hangin pate kithat lo ding a, pate hangin tate kithat lo ding hi. Mi khat pen ama mawhna hang bekin kithat ding hi,” ci-in Mosheh tungtawna kipia Thukham Laibu sunga kigelh bangin amah in mi thatte’ tapate that lo hi.
Amah in Ci Kuampi sungah Edom mite tul sawm that a, Sela simin la a, tua pen Yoktheel ci-in sam a, tuni dongin tua bangin kici lai hi.
Tua ciangin Amazyah in Israyl kumpi Yahu’ tapa Yahahaz, a tapa Yahash kiangah a kitanghlai dingin kamtaite tosakin sawl a, “Hong pai in, kimaitang tuah mah ni!” a cisak hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl kumpi Yahash in Yahdah kumpi Amazyah kiangah hih thu puakkik a, “Lebanon-a om thangling kung khat in Lebanon-a om taamtak kung khat kiangah thu vaikhakin, “Ka tapa a tenpih dingin na tanu hong pia in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin gamsa khat hong pai-in tua thangling a tuancil hi.

Nangmah in Edom na zo taktak a, tua ciangin na lungsim a kiphatsak hi. Na gualzawhna thangsak inla, inn ah om lel in! Nang leh nang tawh a om Yahdah-te a puksak ding buaina sungah bang hangin lutse ding na hi hiam!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Amazyah in manglo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpi Yahash a kuanto hi. Yahdah-a Beth Shemesh ah amah leh Yahdah kumpi Amazyah khat le khat a kimaituah uh hi.
Israyl in Yahdah zo a, mi khempeuh a inn ciat ah a taimang uh hi.

Israyl kumpi Yahash in Beth Shemesh ah Ahazyah’ tapa Yahash, Yahdah kumpi a tapa Amazyah man hi. Tua ciangin Yerusalem ah amah pai-in Ephraim Kulhkongpi panin Kiu Kongpi dong tong zali a sau Yerusalem kulhpi a sucim hi.
Amah in kham leh ngun khempeuh, leh Yahweh’ Inn sung leh kumpi inn-a van manpha koihna sunga nazatte khempeuh la-in a galmatte tawh Samaria ah a ciahkik hi.
Tu-in Yahash uk hun sunga a sep thupiang a omlai teng, a vangliatna leh bangci banga Yahdah kumpi Amazyah a dona cihte, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Yahash a tapate tawh ihmu a, Samaria ah Israyl kumpite tawh a kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Yeroboam in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahahaz’ tapa Israyl kumpipa Yahash a sih zawh Yahdah kumpi Yahash’ tapa Amazyah kum sawm le kum nga a nungta lai hi.
Tu-in Amazyah uk hun sunga thupiang omlaite Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Amaute in Yerusalem ah amah sawmsim uh ahih manin Lachish ah amah a tai hi. Ahih hangin amaute in Lachish ah mi nungdelhsakin, tua lai-ah a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in sakol tungah amah puakik-in David Khuapi sungah a tapate tawh a vui khawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahdah mite khempeuh in kum sawm le kum guk a pha Azaryah la-in a pa Amazyah mun ah kumpi a suaksak uh hi.
Amah in Amazyah a pate tawh a tawlngak zawh ciangin Elath lamkikin Yahdah gam a suaksakkik hi.
Yahdah kumpi Yahash’ tapa Amazyah uk zawh a kum sawm le kum nga kumin Samaria ah Yahash’ tapa Yeroboam Israyl-te kumpi suakin, amah in kum sawmli le kum khat a uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate khempeuh panin amah kihei lo hi.
Amittai’ tapa Gath Hepher pana kamsang a nasem Yahnah tungtawna Israyl Pa Yahweh gensa kammal tawh kizui-in amah in Hamath khua lutna panin Arabah Tuipi; Ci Tuipi, dong Israyl gam a ngahkik hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in nakpi taka Israyl-te thuakna mu a, amaute sila ahi a, sila lo ahi zongin amaute a huh ding khat beek om lo hi.
Yahweh in, “Van nuai panin Israyl’ min ka phiat kei ding hi,” ci khin ahih manin Amah in Yahash’ tapa Yeroboam khutin amaute a honkhia hi.

Tu-in Yeroboam uk hun sunga thupiang omlaite leh a sepsa khempeuh, a vangliatna, bangci banga a galdonate, Damascus leh Hamath pana Yahdah-te neihsate Israyl-te aa dinga a ngahkiknate, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Yeroboam a pate ahi Israyl kumpite tawh ihmu hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Zecharyah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Israyl kumpi Yeroboam uk zawh a kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin Amazyah’ tapa Azaryah Yahdah kumpi a suak hi.
Kumpi a suahin amah kum sawm le kum guk pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnga le kum nih uk hi. A nu’ min pen Yecholyah hi a, Yerusalem pan ahi hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a manin gamta a, a pa Amazyah zuihsa lampi khempeuh zui hi.
Ahih hangin mun sangte a hemkhia kei hi. Mite in mun sangte tungah biakpiakna pia-in paknamtui a hal lai uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in kumpipa vatin a sih dongin phak natna vei a, amah a kikhoina inn sungah a teng hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa’ tapa Yahtham in kumpi-innsungah vaipuak lenin, gam mite thu a khen hi.
Tu-in Azaryah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama sep khempeuh, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Azaryah a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in David Khuapi ah a pate tawh a vui khawm uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Yahtham in a kumpi’ za luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Azaryah uk zawh a kum sawmthum le giat kumin, Yeroboam’ tapa Zecharyah in Samaria ah Israyl-te kha guk sung uk hi.
A pate gamtatsa bang teekteekin Yahweh’ mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate panin a kihei kei hi.
Tua ciangin Yabesh’ tapa Shallum in amah a sawmsim hi. Amah in simin mipite mai-ah thatin a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Tu-in Zecharyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, Israyl kumpite khang thangthu laibu sungah man takin kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Hih pen Yahweh in Yahu tungah, “A khang lina dong Israyl kumpi-tokhom tungah na tapate tu ding hi,” ci-in a gen Yahweh’ kammal a tangtung ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua banga piang ahi hi.
Yahdah kumpi Azaryah uk zawh kum sawmthum le kum kua kumin Yabesh’ tapa Shallum kumpi suak a, amah in Samaria ah kha khat uk hi.
Tirzah panin Samaria ah Gadi’ tapa Menahem pai hi. Amah in Samaria ah Yabesh’ tapa Shallum simin that a, tua khit ciangin a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Tu-in Shallum hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama makaih sawmsimnate, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah man takin kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tirzah panin kipanin Menahem in Tiphsah leh tua huam sunga om khempeuh a do hi. Amaute in a kulhkongpite a hon loh uh ciangin amah in sim a, tua lai-a numei a gai khempeuh a kuikek hi.
Yahdah kumpi Azaryah uk zawh a kum sawmthum le kuana kumin Gadi’ tapa Menahem Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in Samaria ah kum sawm a uk hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialsak mawhnate panin ama nuntak hun sungin amah kihei lo hi.
Tua ciangin Assyria kumpi Pul; Tiglath-Pileser, gam langpanin pai hi. Menahem in ama panpihna ngahin ama let kumpigam a thahat theih nadingin ngun talent 1,000 a pia hi.

Menahem in Israyl panin hanthawnin sum a don ahi hi. Mihau peuhmah in ngun shekel sawmnga a piak uh kul a, tuate Assyria kumpipa tungah a kipia hi. Tua ahih ciangin Assyria kumpipa nungkikin, gam sung tua lai-ah a khawl nawn kei hi.
Tu-in Menahem uk hun sunga thupiang a omlai teng leh ama sep khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Menahem a pate tawh ihmu hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Pekahyah; Pekachyah, in kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Azaryah uk zawh a kum sawmngana kumin, Samaria ah Menahem’ tapa Pekahyah Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in kum nih a uk hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate panin amah a kihei kei hi.

Tua ciangin Remalyah’ tapa a ulian khat ahi Pekah in amah a sawmsim hi. Amah leh Gilead mi sawmnga in Samaria-a kumpi-innkulhpi sungah Pekahyah tawh Argob leh Arieh a that hi. Amah in thatin kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Tu-in Pekahyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh ama sep khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah man takin kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Yahdah kumpi Azaryah uk zawh a kum sawmnga le nihna kumin, Samaria ah Remalyah’ tapa Pekah Israyl-te kumpi suak a, amah in kum sawmnih a uk hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah amah a sia-in gamta hi. Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam in Israyl a khialhsak mawhnate panin amah a kihei kei hi.

Israyl kumpi Pekah uk hun sungin Assyria kumpipa Tiglath-Pileser in Iyon, Abel Beth Maacah, Yanoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead leh Galilee—Naphtali gam khempeuh—do-in man a, tua ciangin a teng mite Assyria ah salin a kai hi.
Elah’ tapa Hoshea in Remalyah’ tapa Pekah langpanna makaih hi. Amah in Pekah simin thatlum a, Yahdah kumpi Azaryah’ tapa Yahtham uk zawh a kum sawmnihna kumin kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Tu-in Pekah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh ama sepsa khempeuh, Israyl kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah man takin kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Israyl kumpi Remalyah’ tapa Pekah uk zawh a kum nihna kumin Azaryah’ tapa Yahtham in Yahdah kumpi-in uk ding kipan hi.
Yahtham kumpi a suakin amah kum sawmnih le kum nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawm le kum guk uk hi. A nu’ min pen Yerushah hi a, Zadok’ tanu ahi hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah amah a manin gamta hi; ahih hangin amah in a pa Azaryah lamlahna zui-in,
mun sangte a hemkhia kei hi. Mite in mun sangte tungah biakpiakna pia-in paknamtui hal lai uh hi. Yahtham in Yahweh’ Inn Kulhkongpi Tungnung lampha hi.
Tu-in Yahtham uk hun sunga thupiang a omlai teng leh ama sep khempeuh, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua hun lai-in Yahweh in Yahdah langah Aram kumpipa Rezin leh Remalyah’ tapa Pekah sawl ding kipan hi.
Tua ciangin Yahtham a pate tawh ihmu a, David Khuapi ah a pate tawh kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Ahaz; Achaz, in kumpi’ za luah hi.
Remalyah’ tapa Pekah uk zawh a kum sawm le kum sagihna kumin, Yahtham’ tapa Ahaz in Yahdah kumpi-in uk ding kipan hi.
Ahaz kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawm le kum guk uk hi. A pa David gamtat bangin Yahweh a Pa mit ah amah a manin gamta lo hi.

Amah in Israyl kumpite lampite a zui hi. Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a nilkhiat minamte’ zat a kihhuai leh a huathuai ngeinate zui-in a tapa nangawn mei sung a nawksak hi. (Etkak: Siam 18:21; Thkna 18:10)
Amah in mun sangte tung, mualtungte leh singnim nuai peuhpeuh ah biakpiakna pia-in paknamtui a hal hi.
Tua ciangin Yerusalem a sim dingin Aram kumpipa Rezin leh Israyl kumpipa Remalyah’ tapa Pekah a kuanto uh hi. Amaute in Ahaz umcih a, ahih hangin amah a zo kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua hun lai-in Aram kumpipa Rezin in Aram aa dingin Elath mankik a, Elath panin Yahdah mite a notkhia hi. Tua ciangin Elath ah Edom mite kikhinin, tuni dongin tua lai-ah teng uh hi.

Ahaz in Assyria kumpi Tiglath-Pileser kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Kei pen na nasempa leh na tapa ka hi hi. Hong pai inla, kei hong sim Aram kumpipa khut pan leh Israyl kumpipa khut panin hong hon in,” a ci hi.
Ahaz in Yahweh’ Inn sung leh kumpi inna van manpha koihna sunga a om ngun leh khamte la-in, Assyria kumpipa kiangah letsongin a khak hi.
Assyria kumpipa in ama ngetna a sang hi. Assyria kumpipa in Damascus simin man a, a sunga teng mite Kir ah salin kai-in Rezin a that hi.
