Tua ciangin kumpi Ahaz in Assyria kumpi Tiglath-Pileser tawh kimu dingin Damascus ah a pai hi. Kumpi Ahaz in Damascus ah biaknatau khat mu a, Siampi Lian Uriyah kiangah a kilamzia leh adung avai tehnate a khak hi.

Tua ciangin Damascus-a kumpi Ahaz kiang pana a ngah a kilamzia leh adung avai tehnate tawh kizui-in Siampi Lian Uriyah in biaknatau khat lam hi. Siampi Lian Uriyah in kumpipa Damascus panin hong tunkik ma-in a zo hi.
Damascus panin kumpipa hong tunkik ciangin biaknatau a mu hi. Biaknatau ah kumpipa paito-in tua tungah biaknate a pia hi.
Amah in a meihal biaknate leh an tawh biaknate a pia hi. Amah in dawna biaknate sungkhia-in biaknatau tungah a kilemna biakna- sisante a theh hi.

Amah in Yahweh’ Inn panin Yahweh mai-a a kitung den sumngo biaknatau la-in Yahweh’ Inn leh biaknatau thak kikalah koih a, biaknatau thak pan leilu lamah a koih hi. Biaknatau thak pen tu-in Yahweh’ Inn a mailam-a a kilatzawkna mun ah kikoih hi.

Tua ciangin kumpi Ahaz in Siampi Lian Uriyah thupia-in, “Hih a lian biaknatau thak tungah zingsang meihal biakna, nitak meihal biakna, kumpipa’ meihal biakna leh an tawh biakna, gam sung mi khempeuh aa dinga meihal biakna leh amaute an tawh biakna leh amaute dawna biaknate pia in. Meihal biaknate leh biakpiaknate-a sisante khempeuh hih biaknatau thak tungah theh in. Ahi zongin keimah in Yahweh kiang thu ka dot nadingin ama sumngo biaknatau ka zang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Siampi Lian Uriyah in kumpi Ahaz thupiak bang teekteekin a hih hi.
Kumpi Ahaz in a kikhin thei leengte tung panin a panga kingaknate satkhia-in tuikuangte a hemkhia hi. Amah in a ngakna sumngo bawngtalte tung panin Tui khinin, suang vial tungah a nga hi.
Amah in Assyria kumpipa’ lungsim leh ngaihsutna hangin Yahweh’ Inn sunga kilamsa Shabbat ni aa dinga a kikhuh lampi lakhia-in, Yahweh’ Inn a pualama kumpipa’ lutna kongpi zong a hemkhia hi.
Tu-in Ahaz uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama septe, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Ahaz a pate tawh ihmu a, David Khuapi ah a pate tawh a kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Hezekyah; Chizkiyah, in kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahdah kumpi Ahaz uk zawh a kum sawm le nihna kumin, Samaria ah Elah’ tapa Hoshea Israyl kumpi suak a, amah in kum kua uk hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta a, ahih hangin ama mai-a Israyl kumpite bangin a hi kei hi.
Assyria kumpi Shalmaneser in Hoshea langpanin kuanto a, Hoshea ama khutnuai mi suakin ama tungah siah a puak hi.

Ahih hangin Assyria kumpipa in Hoshea a lehheekin mu hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Hoshea in Egypt kumpipa So kiangah kamtaite sawlkhin a, kum khat khit kum khat a hih ngei bangin Assyria kumpipa kiangah a siah puak nawn lo hi. Hih thu hangin Assyria kumpipa in amah manin thong sungah henin a koih hi.
Tua ciangin Assyria kumpipa in gam sung khempeuh simin, Samaria do-in pai a, kum thum sung a umcih hi.
Hoshea uk zawh a kum kuana kumin Assyria kumpipa in Samaria manin, Israyl-a tengte Assyria ah a ciahpih hi. Assyria kumpipa in Habor, Habor Gun gei-a Gozan leh Medes khuapite ah amaute a tengsak hi

Hihte khempeuh a pianna a hang pen Israyl-te in a kikham pasiante (elohim) bia-in tuate’ na a sepna uh tawh amaute Egypt pan, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh khut nuai panin a paikhiatpih Yahweh tungah a mawh hang uh ahi hi.
Israyl mite in amau mai panin Yahweh in a notkhiat minamte ngeinate leh amaute a khialsak Israyl kumpite’ lampite a zui uh hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh a Pa uh tungah Israyl mite zuau gamtatin a man lo nate a vaihawm uh hi. Amaute in galvilna tausang panin kulhpi muanhuai ciang dong a khuapite khempeuh ah mun sangte a lam uh hi.

Amaute in a siangtho khuampite; masseboth, a pasian uh (el) Baal etsakna, leh a siangtho singa kibawl khuamte; Asherim, a nusian uh Asherah-Ishtar-Easter etsaknate, mual sang khempeuh leh singnimna peuhpeuh ah phut uh hi.

Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a notkhiat minamte gamtat bang teekteekin a mun sangte khat ciat ah amaute in paknamtui a hal uh hi. Tua lai-ah amaute in siatna lianpi a gamta-in Yahweh a hehsak uh hi—
bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute kiangah, “Hihte na hih kei ding uh hi!” ci-in thu a piak hangin amaute in pasiante’ (elohim) na semin a bia uh hi.

Ahi zongin Yahweh in kamsangte khempeuh leh thumute khempeuh tungtawnin Israyl-te leh Yahdah mite vauhilhin, “Na gamtatsiatnate panun kihei un! A zuih dingun na pate uh ka thupiak leh ka nasem kamsangte tungtawna note tunga kong sawl Thukham tawh kizui-in Ka Thupiaknate leh Ka ngeina kipte zui un,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in ngai lo uh hi. Yahweh a Pa uh a um lo a pate uh mah bangin amaute lungsim khauhin a genhak uh hi.

Amaute in Yahweh’ ngeina kipte leh a pate uh tawh a bawl Ama Thuciamna a nial uh hi. Amah in amaute a vauhilh dingin a sawl a tecipangte nial uh hi. Tua bek tham loin amaute in pasiante (elohim) zui-in pasian-biate (elohim) a suak uh hi! Yahweh in, “Amaute gamtat bangin gamta kei un,” ci-in amaute a gen amau kiimkota minamte khempeuh lampite a zui uh hi.

Amaute in Yahweh a Pa uh Thukhamte khempeuh taisanin, amau aa dingin a geltawm uh biaknatau a kual nih a bawl uh hi. Amaute in Asherah Khuampi khat bawlin, vantunga a honpite khempeuh bia-in Baal zong a bia uh hi.
Amaute in a tapate a tanute uh mei sung nawksak uh hi. Amaute in aisanin khongkhai uh hi. Yahweh mit ah a sia gamta dingin amau le amau kizuakin Amah a hehsak uh hi.
Hih mawhnate hangin Israyl-te tungah Yahweh hehna kuang a, Ama mai panin amaute a hemkhia hi. Yahdah minam bek a omlai hi.
Ahih hangin Yahdah-te nangawnin Yahweh a Pa uh Thukhamte zui lo uh hi. Amaute in zong amau tunga a kigen Israyl-te ngeinate a zui uh hi.
Yahweh in Israyl’ suanlekhakte khempeuh nial hi. Amah in amau gimsakin, Ama muhna panin amaute a notkhiatkhit dongin migilote khut sungah a pia hi.

Amah in David innkuan panin Israyl balkhia a, tua ciangin Israyl in Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam amau kumpi-in a bawl uh hi; tua ciangin Yeroboam in Yahweh zuihna panin Israyl paikhiatpihin amaute mawhna lianpi a bawlsak hi.
Tua ciangin Yeroboam in Israyl-te a khialhsak mawhnate khempeuh amaute in zui-in tuate panin a kihei kei uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in a nasem kamsangte khempeuh tungtawnin a ciamsa bang teekteekin ama muhna panin Israyl a hemkhia hi. Israyl-te pen amau gam mahmah panin Assyria ah salin kikai-in tuni dongin tua bangin a omlai uh hi.

Tua ciangin Assyria kumpipa in Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath leh Sepharvaim pana mite paipih a, Israyl mite tangin Samaria khuapite ah a tengsak hi. Amaute in Samaria la-in a khuapite ah a teng uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in tua lai-ah a tencil-un Yahweh zahtak zia ding amaute kihilh lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in amaute lakah humpinelkaite sawl a, tua in amaute a that hi.

Amaute in Assyria kumpipa kiangah hihthu genin, “Samaria khuapite ah na tensak hih mite in tua gama pasian (el) deihna a thei kei uh hi. Amah in amaute lakah humpinelkaite sawlin, tuate in amaute that hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in tua gama pasian (el) deihna a thei kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Assyria kumpipa in hih thu pia a, “Tua lai pana na lak uh siampite khat puakkik un. Amah pai-in tua lai-ah tengsak unla, tua gam pasian’ deihnate amah in amaute hilhsak un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samaria panin sala kikai siampite khat hong pai-in Beth-El ah a teng hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh a zahtak zia ding uh, amah in amaute a hilh hi.
Ahih hangin minam khat ciat in amau tenna khuapi peuhpeuh ah amau pasiante (elohim) limte a bawl lai uh hi. Amaute in Samariate’ lamsa Mun Sangte tawh Inn sungah tuate a koih khawm uh hi.
Babylon pana mite in Succoth Benoth bawl uh a, Cuthah pana mite in Nergal bawlin, Hamath pana mite in Ashima bawl a,
Avva mite in Nibhaz leh Tartak bawl a, Sepharvaim-te in a Pasian (Elohim) uh ahi Adrammelech leh Anammelech tungah biakpiakna-in mei sungah a tate a hal uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ na a sepzia ding uh amaute tungah kihilh a, ahih hangin amaute in minam khat peuhpeuh panin mun sanga siampite a seh uh hi. Siampite in Innte leh Mun Sangte ah amaute aa dingin na a sepsak uh hi.
Yahweh a biakzia ding uh amaute tungah kihilh a, ahih hangin amaute in amau hong paipih uh minamte ngeinate tawh kizui-in amau pasiante (elohim) mah a bia uh hi.

Tuni dongin amaute in biakzia ngeina luite mah a zom lai uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh zahtak lo uh a, Israyl ci-a min a piak Yaaqob’ tate tungah Yahweh thupiaksa ahi ngeina kipte, biakna ngeinate, Thukhamte leh thupiaknate zong amaute in zui lo uh hi.

Amaute tawh Yahweh in thuciamna khat bawlzo a, amaute kiangah, “Note in a kikham pasiante (elohim) na zahtak kei ding uh a, tuate mai-ah kun loin, tuate na zong na sem kei ding uh a, tuate tungah biakpiakna zong na pia kei ding uh hi;
Ahih hangin a lian vangliatna leh a khut thahat tawh Egypt panin note hong paikhiatpih Yahweh na zahtak ding uh a, note in amah bia-in, ama tungah biakpiaknate na pia ding uh hi.
Note aa dingin Ama gelhsa ngeina kipte, biakna ngeinate, Thukhamte leh thupiaknate limtakin kanin na zui tawntung ding uh hi. A kikham pasiante zahtak kei un.
Note tawh ka bawl thuciamna na mangngilh kei ding uh a, a kikham pasiante (elohim) zong na zahtak kei ding uh hi.
Note in Yahweh na Pa uh na zahtak ding uh a, Amah in na galte khempeuh khut panin nang hong hon ding hi,” ci-in thu a piakhin hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in mang loin a ngeina luite a zom lai uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh zahtak zia ding hih minamte tungah kihilh a, ahih hangin amaute in amau pasiante (elohim) mah bia-in tuate’ na a sem uh hi. A tate leh a tute in tuni dongin a pate uh gamtatnate a zomsuak uh hi.
Elah’ tapa Israyl kumpi Hoshea uk zawh a kum thumna kumin, Ahaz’ tapa Hezekyah in Yahdah kumpi-in uk ding kipan hi.
Kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih le kum nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnih le kum kua a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Abiyah hi a, Zecharyah’ tanu ahi hi.
A pa David gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in Yahweh mit ah amah a manin gamta hi.

Amah in mun sangte nangawn hemkhia-in, a siangtho khuampi; masseboth, sukham a, sing tawh a kibawl Asherah Khuampite a sattan hi. Amah in Mosheh bawlsa sumngo gul a nenin suzan hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua hun dongin Israyl-te in tua kiangah paknamtui a hal uh hi. (Amah in tua pen Nehustan; Kham-Gul a Sianglo Na hi, a ci hi.)
Hezekyah in Israyl’ Pa Yahweh muang hi. Ama ma-a hitaleh ama khit ah hitaleh Yahdah kumpite khempeuh lakah amah tawh a kibang khat beek omlo hi.
Amah in Yahweh kiptakin len a, Amah a zuihna panin pial lo hi. Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawna thu a piak Ama thupiaknate amah in zui hi.
Yahweh in amah ompih hi; tua ahih ciangin a paina peuhpeuh amah gualzo hi. Amah in Assyria zong lehdo zo a, ama na a sem kei hi.
Amah in galvilna tausang panin kulha ki-um khuapi ciang leh Gaza leh a ukna gam ciang dong ah Philistia-te a khutnuai mi a suaksak hi.
Yahdah Kumpi Hezekyah uk zawh a kum lina kum pen Elah’ tapa Israyl kumpi Hoshea uk zawh a kum sagihna kum hi a, tua kumin Assyria kumpipa Shalmaneser in Samaria sim dingin kuanin a umcih hi.
Kum thum a cin ciangin amaute in Samaria lazo uh hi. Hezekyah uk zawh a kum gukna kum, Israyl kumpi Hoshea uk zawh a kum kuana kumin Samaria kila hi.
Assyria kumpipa in Assyria ah Israyl-te salin kai-in Halah, Habor Gun gei-a Gozan leh Medes khuapite ah a tengsak hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite in Yahweh a Pa uh thu manglo uh hi. Amaute in a Thuciamna leh Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh thupiaksa khempeuh palsat uh hi. Amaute in tuate ngai lo a, zui zong zui loin a sem kei uh hi.
Kumpi Hezekyah uk zawh a kum sawm le lina kumin Yahdah khuapi muanhuaite khempeuh sim dingin Assyria kumpi Sennacherib kuanin tuate a la hi.

Tua ciangin Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah in Lachish-a om Assyria kumpipa kiangah thu puakin, “Ka khialkhin hi. Kei kiang panin nungkik inla, tua ciangin keimah in nong nget peuhpeuh kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Assyria kumpipa in Yahdah kumpipa Hezekyah kiangah ngun talent zathum; tan 11 kiim, leh kham talent sawmthum; tan 1 kiim, a kal hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hezekyah in Yahweh’ Inn leh kumpi-inn van manpha koihna om ngun khempeuh amah a pia hi.
Tua hun lai-in Hezekyah in Yahweh’ Inn-a kongkhakte leh kongmungte panin amah mah koih khamte hawkkhia-in Assyria kumpipa tungah a pia hi.

Tua ciangin Assyria kumpipa in Lachish panin galkap honpi khat tawh Yerusalem lamah a galkap mang lianpen; Tartan, a uliante ukpa; Rabsaris, leh a galkap mang khat; Rabshaketh, a sawl hi. Amaute kuankhia-in Yerusalem ah tung uh a, Puansawppa’ Lo zuatna lam lianpi kianga Bual Tungnung tuilakna tuilam ah a khawl uh hi.

Amaute in kumpipa sam uh a, ahih hangin amaute kiangah Hilkiyah’ tapa kumpi-inn sung ukpa Elyakim, lai-atpa Shebna leh Asaph tapa thuciamteh Yahach-te a pai uh hi. 19 Tua ciangin galkap mangpa; Rabshakeh, in amaute kiangah, “Hezekyah kiangah hih thu gen un: Hih in a lian kumpi Assyria kumpipa thugen ahi hi: ‘Bang bukna a muang na hi hiam?”
Note in galsiamna leh galhatna ka nei, na ci uh hi; ahih hangin tuate kammal hawmpi hi! Kua muangin kei hong lehdo na hi hiam?

En in, a tungah a kingam mipa’ khut a sun pumpeeng kung kitam a bang lel Egypt tungah kinga na hih uh leh, amah in nang hong nasak lel ding hi! Ama sungah a bute khempeuh aa dingin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tua bang ahi lel hi!

Nangmah in kei kiangah, ‘Kote in Yahweh ka Pa uh ka muang uh hi,’ nong cih uh leh, Amah pen Hezekyah in ama mun sangte leh biaknataute hepkhiatsakin, Yahdah leh Yerusalem tungah, ‘Yerusalem-a hih biaknatau mai ah na bia hamtang ding uh hi,’ a cih pa hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in ka ukpa uh Assyria kumpipa tawh thukimna bawl un; no lam panin a tuang ding a ngah nak uhleh note tungah sakol tulnih kong pia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in sakolleengte leh sakol tung tuangte hangin Egypt a muang na hih uh leh, ka ukpa uliante a neupen khat bangci bangin lehnotzo ding na hi uh hiam?
Tua tham loin Yahweh kiang panin thu omlo pi-in hih mun simin a susia dingin hong pai ka hi hiam? Yahweh in kei kiangah, ‘Kuanto inla, hih gam simin susia in,’ hong ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Hilkiyah’ tapa Elyakim, Shebna leh Yahach in tua Rabshakeh dawngin, “Na nasemte kiangah Aramaic pau-in hong gen in, ko ka thei uh hi; ahih hangin kulh tunga om mite zakin ko tungah Hebrew pau-in hong gen kei in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin tua Rabshakeh in amaute kiangah, “Ka ukpa in hih thute na ukpa tung bek ah ahi hiam? Note tawh a kibang amau ek mah ne-in amau zun mah a dawn kulh tunga a tu mite tungah zong hong gensak lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua Rabshakeh dingto-in Hebrew kamin awngin, “A lian kumpi Assyria kumpipa kammal za un!
Kumpipa thu gen hi bang ahi hi: Hezekyah kikhemsak kei un! Keima khut panin amah in note hong hon zo lo ding hi!
Hezekyah in note tungah, ‘Yahweh in eite hong hon taktak ding a, Assyria kumpipa khut sungah hih khuapi kipia lo ding hi,’ ci-in Yahweh na muan nadingun kizolsak kei un.

-32 Hezekyah thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Kei tawh kilemna bawl unla kei kiangah hong pusuak un! Kei hong pai-in, an leh leenggui thak leitang, anlum leh leenggui lo leitang, olive kungte leh khuaizu omna leitang nomau aa mah a bang gam ah kong paipih ni matengin mi khempeuh in ama leenggui pan leh ama theikung panin ne ding uh a, nomau tuikhuk ciat panin tui na dawn ding uh hi. Nuntakna teel unla sihna teel kei un! Hezekyah thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in note hong khemin, ‘Yahweh in ei hong hon ding hi,’ ci ding hi!
Minamte khatpeuh pasian in Assyria kumpipa khut panin a gam hon ngei ahi hiam?
Hamath-te leh Arphad’ te pasiante koi-ah om ahi hiam? Sepharvaim-te, Hena-te leh Ivvah-te pasiante koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tuate in keima khut panin Samaria hon ngei ahi hiam?
Hih gamte pasiante khempeuh panin kua in kei kiang panin ama gam hon thei ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin kei khut panin Yahweh in Yerusalem bangci hut zo ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite dai dide-in kam khat beek dawngkik lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa’ thupiakna pen, ‘Amah dawng kei un,’ cih ahi hi.

Tua ciangin Hilkiyah’ tapa kumpi innsung ukpa Elyakim, lai-at Shebna leh Asaph’ tapa thuciamteh Yahach-te Hezekyah kiangah puan balkeksa-in kilehkik uh a, tua Rabshakeh; galkap mangpa, thugente ama kiangah a ko uh hi.
Kumpipa in hih thu a zak ciangin amah in a puante balkek a, ippi puan silhin Yahweh’ Inn sungah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpi innsung ukpa Elyakim, lai-at Shebna leh siampite laka upate a vekpi-in ippi puan silhin Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah kiangah a sawl hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, “Hezekyah in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Tuni pen lungkham ni, tai thuak ni, mindai ni hi a, naungek suah hun tunga hinkhiat nading tha a om nawn loh ni tawh kibang hi.

A ukpa Assyria kumpipa in a Nungta Pa a zahko dingin a sawl tua Rabshakeh; galkap mangpa, kammalte khempeuh Yahweh na Pa in na za henla, Yahweh na Pa in a zaksa thute na mawhsak tahen. Tua ahih ciangin a omlai sunte aa dingin thu ngen in,’ ci hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Hezekyah uliante hih thu a puak dingin Isayah kiangah a pai uh hi.

Tua ciangin Isayah in amaute kiangah, “Na ukpa kianga na gen ding thu hi bang ahi hi: ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: na zaksa uh thute hangin lau kei un, Assyria kumpipa’ nasempa kammalte in Kei hong gensiasia hi.

En in, keimah in ama sungah kha khat ka koih ding a, thuzaksakna khat a zak ciangin a gam ah ciahkik ding hi. Tua khit ciangin keimah in ama gam sung mah ah namsau khat tawh amah a sattuk nadingin ka bawl ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Lachish nusia hi, cih thu a zak ciangin tua Rabshakeh ciahkik a, Assyria kumpipa in Libna a dona a mu hi.
Tu-in Egypt-a Nile a tunglam kuam pana Cush-te kumpipa Tirhakah in amah do dingin a kuantohna thu Sennacherib in a za hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in Hezekyah kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl leuleu a,
“Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah kiangah gen in: Assyria kumpipa khut sungah Yerusalem kipia lo ding hi,’ cihna tawh na muan pasian (el) kikhem sam kei in.
En in, amaute khempeuh susia kiuhkeuhin gam khempeuh tunga Assyria kumpipa’ hihna thu na zakhin hi! Tua hi a, nang hong kihon ding ahi hiam?
Ka pu ka pate susiat Gozan-te, Haran-te, Rezeph-te leh Tel Assar gam sunga Eden mite pasiante (elohim), tua minamte pasiante in amaute hon ahi hiam?
Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim mite khuapi-a kumpipa, Hena kumpipa leh Ivvah kumpipa koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Hezekyah in kamtaite khut panin hih laikhak ngahin a sim hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn ah Hezekyah paito-in Yahweh mai-ah a zalkhia hi.
Hezekyah in Yahweh mai-ah thu ngen a, “Cherub-te kikala a teng Israyl Pa Yahweh aw, leitung kumpigam khempeuh lakah nangmah bek Vanglianpa na hi hi. Nangmah in vantungte leh leitung na bawlkhin hi.
Yahweh aw, na bil hong ngat inla hong za in. Yahweh aw, na mit hak inla, hong mu in. A Nungta Pa a simmawh dingin Sennacherib sawlsa thute ngai in.
Yahweh aw, Assyria kumpite in minamte leh a gamte a suksiatna thu a man hi a,
a pasiante (elohim) uh mei sungah paai-in a susia uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate lakah a Vanglian khat beek omlo a—tuate pen mihingte’ khuta bawlsa sing leh suang ahi lel hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh kote Pa aw, kong thuum hi, ama khut panin kote hong hon in, tua hileh leitung kumpigam khempeuh in nang, nangmah bek Vanglian Pa na hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amoz’ tapa Isayah in Hezekyah kiangah hih thu puak a, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Assyria kumpipa Senacherib tawh kisai-a na thungetna ka zakhin hi.
Hih in amah tawh kisai-in a kigen Yahweh’ kammal ahi hi: Zion’ Ta Nungak in nang hong simmawhin hong zahpih hi. Yerusalem’ Tanu in na taikek ciangin a lu hong peisan hi!
Kua zahko-in kua simmawh na hi hiam? Kua langpanin na aw sangsakin, kiphatsakna tawh na mit liik na hi hiam? Israyl-te’ Siangthopa hi!

Na kamtaite tungtawnin nangmah in Yahweh na zahko a, ‘Ka sakolleeng honpite tawh mual sangte tungah ka kahtokhin a, Lebanon gam tawng pek dong ka tung khin hi. Taamtak sangpente leh taaksan hoihpente ka phukkhin hi. Gam sung tawngnung pen te dong ka tungkhin a, a taam hoihpente dong ka tungkhin hi.
Gamdangte gam ah tuikhukte ka tokhin a, tua lai-ah tui ka dawnkhin hi. Ka khepeek tawh Egypt gam sunga luite khempeuh ka keusakkhin hi,’ na ci hi.

Hihte sawt pek lai-a ka sehsa a hih lam za ngei lo na hi hiam? Tanglai hunte-a kipanin tuate ka geelsa hilo ahi hiam? Kulha ki-um khuapite gawi-in suangthem leithem lompi na suahsak nadingin tu-in a tungsakkhin ka hi hi!
Tua ahih ciangin a mite hatna teng kihupkangin, amaute patau-in lungbuai uh hi. Amaute pen lo sunga singnote, lo ngekte, innkumzanga lopate tawh kibang uh a—a khankhit ma-in a keu uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in na omna mun, na ciah na kuan ciang leh bangci banga kei tungah nakpi taka na hehna ka thei hi!

Kei tunga na hehluatna hang leh na kiphatsak luatna in ka bilte bankhin ahih manin Keimah in na nak ah Ka sikkawi ka bulh ding a, na kam ah Ka kamkaih vawhin, nong kuanna lam mah ah kong kilehsakkik ding hi,’ a ci hi.

Hezekyah aw, hih pen nang aa dingin lim hi ding hi: ‘Tu kumin ama thu-a a potawmte na ne ding a, a kum nihna ciangin tuate pana a selkhiate na ne ding hi. Ahih hangin a kum thumna ciangin khai tuhin atin, leengguite suanin a gah ne in.
Tua ciangin Yahdah innkuan a suakta a omlai sunte in a nuailam ah zungkha kik ding uh a, a tunglam ah a gah ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yerusalem panin a omlai sunte leh Zion Mual panin a suaktate hong pai ding uh hi. Vanglianpen Yahweh’ deihluatna in hih thu hong sem ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Assyria kumpipa tawh kisai-in Yahweh genna hi bang ahi hi: ‘Hih khuapi sungah amah lut lo ding a, hih lai-ah thaltang khat zong lawn kha lo ding hi. Khuapi mai-ah lum tawh zong amah kuan lo ding a, umcihna phuung zong a ciang kei ding hi.
Ama hong kuanna lampi ah amah ciahkik ding hi. Hih khuapi ah amah lut lo ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ka nasempa David leh Keimah ka kikhualna-in hih khuapi hu-in hih khuapi ka dal ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua zanin Yahweh’ vantungmi kuankhia-in Assyria mite giahphual ah lut a, mi 185,000 a that hi. Zingsang tuungin amaute a thawh uh ciangin tua lai-ah misi luanghawm khempeuh na om hi!
Tua ahih ciangin tua mun panin Assyria kumpi Sennacherib a paikhia hi. Amah paikhia-in Nineveh ah ciahkikin tua lai-ah a om hi.

Ni khat, amah in ama Pasian (El) Nisroch’ inn sungah a biakbiak laitakin a tapate ahi Adrammelech leh Sharezer in namsau tawh amah a sattuk hi. Amaute Ararat gam sungah tai-in suakta uh a, a tapa Esarhaddon in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.

Tua hun lai-in Hezekyah a cina-in si dektakin a lum hi. Ama kiangah Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah pai-in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na innkuan vai ding hawm in. Nang na si ding a, na nungta kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a maitang kawm lam ngatin Yahweh tungah thungen a,
“Yahweh aw, kong thuum hi; Nangma mai-ah lungsim kicing takin thuman sungah ka kalsuanna leh Nangma mit ah a manin ka gamtatna hong phawk in,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin Hezekyah nakpi takin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin Isayah in inntual laita a khen ma-in ama tungah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a,

“Kilehkik in. Ka mite a ukpa Hezekyah kiangah, ‘Na pa David’ Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na thungetna ka zakhin hi; Na khituite ka mukhin a, nang kong damsak taktak ding hi. A ni thumna ni-in Yahweh’ Inn ah na paito ding hi.

Na nuntakna ah kum sawm le kum nga ka behlap ding hi. Assyria kumpipa khut panin nang leh hih khuapi kong hon ding a, Ka nasempa David ka cihna hang leh keimah ka kikhualna hangin hih khuapi ka dal ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Isayah in, “Theigah tawh kibawl meima tungah belh ding khat hong la un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in bawl uh a, meimatum tungah koihin amah a dam hi.
Hezekyah in Isayah kiangah, “Yahweh in kei hong damsak ding leh a ni thumna ni-in Yahweh’ Inn ah ka paitoh ding a lim bang hi ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Isayah in, “Yahweh in hong ciamsa banga a sep ding pen Ama kiang pana nang aa ding lim ahi hi: Teel in—niliim kal sawm mai pai zaw ding hiam, ahih keileh kal sawm nungkik zaw ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Hezekyah in, “Niliim kal sawm a mainawt ding a baih khat ahi hi: tua ahih ciangin niliim kal sawm nungkiksak zaw in,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh tungah kamsang Isayah kiko a, tua ciangin Yahweh in Ahaz’ kahlei tunga niliim a mainawtnasa mun panin niliim kal sawm a nungkiksak hi.
Tua hun lai-in Baladan’ tapa Babylon kumpipa Merodach-Baladan in Hezekyah a cinatna thu za ahih manin ama kiangah laikhakte leh letsong khat a khak hi.

Hezekyah in amaute zin na do a, tua khit ciangin amah in van manpha koihna sung leh van kholna sunga om khempeuh, ngun leh kham, paknamtuite leh sathau leh a galvan khempeuh—van manpha koihna leh van kholna sunga a kimu khempeuh amaute a lak hi. Hezekyah in a inn sungah hitaleh a kumpigam sungah hitaleh amau tungah a lah loh khat beek a om kei hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpi Hezekyah kiangah kamsang Isayah pai-in, “Hih mite in bang hong gen a, koi panin hong pai uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Hezekyah in, “Amaute pen mun gamlapi Babylon panin hong pai uh ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Isayah in, “Amaute in na inn sungah bang mu ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Hezekyah in, “Amaute in ka inn sunga om khempeuh a mu uh hi. Ka van manpha koihna lakah amaute ka lah loh khat beek a om kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Isayah in Hezekyah kiangah, “Yahweh’ kammal ngai in!
En in, a hun hong tung ta hi; na inn sunga om khempeuh leh tuni dongin na pate in a kholsa khempeuh Babylon ah kipua mang ding hi. Bangmah cian lo ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in nang sung pana piang na si leh sa ahi nangma tapate kimkhat paikhiatpih ding uh a, amaute pen Babylon kumpipa’ kumpi-inn ah cilgeh innsung mangte ahi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Hezekyah in Isayah kiangah, “Na gensa Yahweh’ kammal a man hi!” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a lungsim sungah, “A tawmpen kei nuntak sungin kilemna leh lungmuanna om buang lo ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

Tu-in Hezekyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama vangliatna khempeuh leh bual a bawlzia leh lei tovangin khuapi sungah tui a tunsakziate, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Hezekyah a pate tawh a ihmu hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Menasheh in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Menasheh kumpi a suahin amah kum sawm le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnga le kum nga uk hi. A nu’ min pen Hephzebah ahi hi.
Yahweh mit ah amah a sia-in gamta a, Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a notkhiat minam khempeuhte a kihhuai leh a huathuai gamtatnate a zui hi.

Amah kihei-in a pa Hezekyah suksiatsa mun sangte a lamkik hi. Amah in Israyl kumpi Ahab hihsa mah bangin Baal aa dingin biaknataute koihin, sing tawh kibawl Asherah Khuampi lam a, amah in vantunga a honpite; ni, kha leh aksite, bia-in tuate na a sem hi. (Etkak: Siam 18:21; Thkna 18:10)
Yahweh in, “Yerusalem ah Ka Min ka kipsak ding hi,” ci-in a gensa Yahweh’ Inn sungah zong biaknataute a lam hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ Inn tual tenih ah vantunga a honpite khempeuh aa dingin biaknataute a lam hi.
Amah in mei sungah zong a tapa nawksak a, mailam thu genkholhna, aisannate gamta-in, khate leh vankahte thu a dong hi. Amah in Yahweh mit ah siatna lianpi bawl-in Amah a hehsak hi.

-8 Yahweh in David leh a tapa Solomon tungah, ‘Israyl minam khempeuh panin ka teelkhiat hih Inn leh Yerusalem sungah Ka Min ka kipsak tawntung ding a, Israyl mite in amaute tungah ka thupiakte limtakin hihin, Ka nasempa Mosheh khut tung panin amaute ka piak Thukham khempeuh a zuih nak uh leh, a pate uh tunga ka piak gam panin Israyl mite’ khe ka vakvai sakkik kei ding hi,’ ci-in a gen Inn ahi Yahweh’ Inn sung nangawn ah Asherah Khuampi lamin a tung hi.
Ahih hangin mite in hilhkholhnate ngai loin Menasheh in amaute a makaih khial hi. Yahweh in Israyl mite mai pana a suksiat minamte sangin amah in amaute a siazaw gamtatna ah a zol hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in a nasem kamsangte tungtawnin thu gen a,
“Yahdah kumpipa Menasheh in hih a kihhuai nate sem a, ama ma-a Amor mite khempeuh sangin gilozaw-in gamta a, ama pasian (elohim) limte tawh Yahdah-te zong a mawh a suaksak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl’ Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, a za peuhpeuh bil tenih a vut ding Yerusalem leh Yahdah tungah tua bang siatna ka tungsak ding hi!
Keimah in Samaria tunga ka zat pikhau leh Ahab innkuan tunga ka zat saval zangin Yerusalem ka teh ding hi. Mi khat in kuan a nulkhiat bangin Yerusalem ka nulkhia ding a, nulkhia-in ka lumlet ding hi.
Ka gamhluah a omlai sunte ka taisan ding a, a galte uh khut sungah amaute ka pia ding hi. Amaute pen a galte luhgawp leh van matte suak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt panin a pate a paikhiat ni-a kipan tuni mahmah dong Keima mit ah amaute a sia gamta-in, kei hong hehsak uh hi.

Tua bek tham loin Menasheh in Yahweh’ mit ah a sia gamtatsakna tawh Yahdah mite a khialhsak mawhna banah amah in Yerusalem mong khat panin mong khat dong sisan a dim dongin mawh baanglo sisan tampi tak zong a luangsak hi.
Tu-in Menasheh uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama sep khempeuh, leh ama khialh mawhna, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin Menasheh a pate tawh ihmu-in, Uzza’ huan sung, ama inn huang sungah kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Amon in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Amon kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum nih a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Meshullemeth hi a, Yotbah-a Haruz’ tanu ahi hi.
Amon in a pa Menasheh gamtatsa bang teekteekin Yahweh’ mit ah a sia-in gamta hi.
Amah in a pa’ zuih lampi khempeuh zui a, a pa in tuate’ na semin a pa’ biak pasiante (elohim) khempeuh’ na a sem hi.
Amah in a pate Pa Yahweh nusia a, Yahweh’ lampi a zui kei hi.
Tua ciangin Amon’ uliante kikopin sawmsim uh a, ama inn sung mah ah kumpipa a that uh hi.
Ahih hangin gam sung mipite in kumpi Amon suamlumte khempeuh that uh hi. Tua khit ciangin gam sung mipite in ama mun ah tapa Yoshiyah kumpi a suaksak uh hi.
Tu-in Amon uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh ama septe, Yahdah kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Amah pen Uzza’ huan sung ama han ah a kivui hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Yoshiyah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yoshiyah kumpi a suahin amah kum giat pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum 31 uk hi. A nu’ min pen Yedidah hi a, Bozkath-a Adayah’ tanu ahi hi.
Yahweh’ mit ah amah a manin gamta a, a pa David lampite khempeuh a zui hi. Amah, veilam ahi a, taklam ahi zongin a pial kei hi.
Kumpi Yoshiyah uk zawh a kum sawm le kum giat kumin amah in Yahweh’ Inn ah Meshullam’ tapa Azalyah, a tapa lai-at Shaphan sawl a,
“Siampi Lian Hilkiyah kiangah paito inla, kongcingte in mite kiang pana a khol uh Yahweh’ Inn sungah a kipaipih sumte simsak in.
Yahweh’ Inn-a nasemna a van dingin a kiseh mite tungah tua sumte piasak in. Yahweh’ Inn-a nasemte,
khutsiamte, innlamte leh leilesuang tawh innlamte tungah a piak ding leh Yahweh’ Inn puah nadingin sing leh suang atsa lei nadingin nasep vante tungah ap in.
Ahih hangin amaute in thumaan takin gamta uh ahih manin amaute tungah muanna tawh a ki-ap sumte hangin amaute tung panin sazin kingen lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Siampi Lian Hilkiyah in lai-at Shaphan kiangah, “Yahweh’ Inn sungah Thukham Laibu ka mu hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Hilkiyah in Shaphan tungah tua laibu pia-in, tua ciangin amah in a sim hi.
Kumpipa kiangah lai-at Shaphan ciahkikin, ama kiangah, “Na nasemte in Yahweh’ Inn a om sumte simkhin uh a, amaute in nasem vante tung leh Yahweh’ Inn a nasemte tungah piakhin uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin lai-at Shaphan in kumpipa kiangah, “Siampi Lian Hilkiyah in Laibu khat hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shaphan in kumpipa kiangah a sim hi.
Kumpipa in Thukham Laibu sunga kammalte a zak ciangin, amah in a puante a balkek hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Siampi Lian Hilkiyah tung, Micahyah’ tapa Achbor tung, lai-at Shaphan tung leh kumpipa ulian khat ahi Asayah tungah thu pia-in,

Pai unla hih a kimu Laibu sunga thute tawh kisai-in kei aa ding, mipite aa ding leh Yahdah khempeuh aa dingin Yahweh kiangah va dong un.
